title.zh: 卷三百一十 列傳第一百九十八 土司
title.raw: 卷三百一十 列傳第一百九十八 土司 Volume 310 Biographies 198: Tribal Headmen

sentences.zh: 西南諸蠻，有虞氏之苗，商之鬼方，西漢之夜郎、靡莫、邛、莋、僰、爨之屬皆是也。

translations.literal: The various tribes of the southwest include the Miao of the Yu clan, the Guifang of the Shang, and the Yelang, Mimo, Qiong, Zhuo, Bo, and Cuan groups of the Western Han — all were of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: The tribal peoples of the southwest — the Miao of the Yu clan, the Guifang of the Shang, and the Yelang, Mimo, Qiong, Zhuo, Bo, and Cuan of the Western Han — all belong to this category.

sentences.zh: 自巴、夔以東及湖、湘、嶺嶠，盤踞數千里，種類殊別。

translations.literal: From Ba and Kui eastward through Hunan, Xiang, and the Ling ranges, they held sway over several thousand li, with many distinct peoples.
translations.idiomatic: From Ba and Kui eastward through Hunan, the Xiang region, and the Ling ranges, they occupied several thousand li of territory, divided into many distinct groups.

sentences.zh: 歷代以來，自相君長。

translations.literal: Through successive dynasties they made one another their own rulers.
translations.idiomatic: Through successive dynasties they recognized one another as rulers among themselves.

sentences.zh: 原其為王朝役使，自周武王時孟津大會，而庸、蜀、羌、髳、微、盧、彭、濮諸蠻皆與焉。

translations.literal: Tracing when they began serving the dynastic house, it was from King Wu of Zhou at the great assembly at Mengjin, when the tribes of Yong, Shu, Qiang, Mao, Wei, Lu, Peng, and Pu all took part.
translations.idiomatic: As for when they first came to serve the imperial house, that dates to King Wu of Zhou at the great assembly at Mengjin, when the Yong, Shu, Qiang, Mao, Wei, Lu, Peng, and Pu tribes all participated.

sentences.zh: 及楚莊蹻王滇，而秦開五尺道，置吏，沿及漢武，置都尉縣屬，仍令自保，此即土官、土吏之所始歟。

translations.literal: When Zhuang Qiao of Chu became king of Dian, Qin opened the Five-Foot Road and appointed officials; this continued through Emperor Wu of Han, who set up commandants and county subordinates yet still let them keep themselves — is this not where native officials and native clerks had their beginning?
translations.idiomatic: When Zhuang Qiao of Chu made himself king of Dian, Qin opened the Five-Foot Road and posted officials; under Emperor Wu of Han commandants and counties were established, yet the people were still left to govern themselves — and is this not where native officials and native clerks had their beginning?

sentences.zh: 迨有明踵元故事，大為恢拓，分別司郡州縣，額以賦役，聽我驅調，而法始備矣。

translations.literal: When the Ming followed Yuan precedent and greatly expanded control, they divided pacification commissions, prefectures, and counties, assessed taxes and corvée, and allowed themselves to be mobilized — only then was the system complete.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming, following Yuan precedent, the court greatly extended its reach, apportioned pacification commissions, prefectures, and counties, levied taxes and corvée, and accepted their service on campaign — and only then was the system fully in place.

sentences.zh: 然其道在於羈縻。

translations.literal: Yet the way lay in loose-rein pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the governing principle remained loose-rein pacification.

sentences.zh: 彼大姓相擅，世積威約，而必假我爵祿，寵之名號，乃易為統攝，故奔走惟命。

translations.literal: Those great clans monopolized power among themselves, accumulating authority through generations, yet had to borrow our ranks and stipends and be honored with titles before they could be easily brought under control; hence they rushed to obey.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful clans held sway among themselves, their authority built up over generations, yet they had to rely on our ranks and stipends and on the honor of imperial titles before they could be readily governed — and so they hurried to do our bidding.

sentences.zh: 然調遣日繁，急而生變，恃功怙過，侵擾益深，故歷朝征發，利害各半。

translations.literal: Yet as summonses grew daily more frequent, urgency bred revolt; relying on merit they shielded their faults, and encroachment and harassment grew worse — hence through the dynasties campaigns were launched, with benefit and harm in equal measure.
translations.idiomatic: But as requisitions grew ever more frequent, haste bred rebellion; they leaned on past merit to excuse present faults, and raids and encroachments deepened — so that through the dynasties expeditions were launched, with gain and loss about evenly matched.

sentences.zh: 其要在於撫綏得人，恩威兼濟，則得其死力而不足為患。

translations.literal: The key lay in winning the right men for pacification, combining kindness and severity, then gaining their utmost loyalty without their becoming a menace.
translations.idiomatic: The essential lay in appointing the right men to pacify them and combining kindness with severity — then one could win their utmost loyalty without their becoming a threat.

sentences.zh: 《實錄》載成化十八年馬平主簿孔性善言：「谿峒蠻僚，雖常梗化，亂豈無因。

translations.literal: The 《Veritable Records》 record that in the eighteenth year of Chenghua, Kong Xingshan, registrar of Maping, said: "The tribes of the stream valleys and mountain passes, though often obstructing transformation, do not rebel without cause.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Veritable Records》 note that in Chenghua 18, Kong Xingshan, registrar of Maping, said: "The tribal peoples of stream valleys and mountain passes, though they often resist assimilation, do not rise without provocation.

sentences.zh: 昔陳景文為令，瑤、僮皆應差徭，厥後撫字乖方，始仍反側。

translations.literal: Formerly when Chen Jingwen was magistrate, the Yao and Zhuang all answered corvée levies; afterward misrule in care and nurture began, and they turned rebellious again.
translations.idiomatic: In the past, when Chen Jingwen served as magistrate, Yao and Zhuang alike met corvée obligations; later, when local governance failed, they turned rebellious once more.

sentences.zh: 誠使守令得人，示以恩信，諭以禍福，亦當革心。

translations.literal: If prefects and magistrates were truly well chosen, shown kindness and trust, and instructed in fortune and disaster, they too would change their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: If only the right prefects and magistrates were appointed, shown kindness and trust, and taught what gain and ruin would bring, they too would mend their ways.

sentences.zh: 」帝嘉納之，惜未能實究其用，此可為治蠻之寶鑒矣。

translations.literal: " The emperor praised and accepted this, yet regretted that it could not be thoroughly applied — this may serve as a treasured mirror for governing the tribes.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor praised and accepted the advice, yet regretted that it could not be fully put into practice — a lesson that remains a treasured mirror for governing tribal peoples.

sentences.zh: 嘗考洪武初，西南夷來歸者，即用原官授之。

translations.literal: It has been observed that at the beginning of Hongwu, when southwestern tribes came to submit, their original offices were at once conferred upon them.
translations.idiomatic: It is recorded that at the outset of Hongwu, when southwestern tribes submitted, they were immediately confirmed in their former offices.

sentences.zh: 其土官銜號曰宣慰司，曰宣撫司，曰招討司，曰安撫司，曰長官司。

translations.literal: Their native-official titles were Pacification Commission, Pacification Superintendent, Bandit-Suppression Commission, Comforting Commission, and Chieftain's Office.
translations.idiomatic: Their native-official titles ran: Pacification Commission, Pacification Superintendent, Bandit-Suppression Commission, Comforting Commission, and Chieftain's Office.

sentences.zh: 以勞績之多寡，分尊卑之等差，而府州縣之名亦往往有之。

translations.literal: According to the amount of merit, higher and lower grades were distinguished, and the names of prefectures and counties also often appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Merit determined rank, high or low, and the designations of prefectures and counties also often appeared among them.

sentences.zh: 襲替必奉朝命，雖在萬里外，皆赴闕受職。

translations.literal: Succession had to await the court's command; even ten thousand li away, all went to the capital to receive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Succession required imperial sanction; even from ten thousand li away, heirs went to court to receive appointment.

sentences.zh: 天順末，許土官繳呈勘奏，則威柄漸弛。

translations.literal: At the end of Tianshun, native officials were allowed to submit memorials for investigation and approval, and authority gradually slackened.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Tianshun reign, native officials were permitted to submit memorials for review and approval, and imperial control gradually loosened.

sentences.zh: 成化中，令納粟備振，則規取日陋。

translations.literal: In the Chenghua period they were ordered to contribute grain for famine relief, and the rules for advancement grew shabbier by the day.
translations.idiomatic: During Chenghua they were required to contribute grain for famine relief, and standards for promotion grew shabbier day by day.

sentences.zh: 孝宗雖發憤厘革，而因循未改。

translations.literal: Though Emperor Xiaozong angrily sought to reform abuses, inertia left things unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong, though he angrily sought to reform abuses, found old habits unchanged.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖九年始復舊制，以府州縣等官隸驗封，宣慰、招討等官隸武選。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Jiajing the former system was restored: prefectural and county officials were placed under Credential Verification, while pacification and bandit-suppression offices were placed under Military Selection.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 9 the old system was restored: prefectural and county officials fell under Credential Verification, while pacification and bandit-suppression offices fell under Military Selection.

sentences.zh: 隸驗封者，布政司領之；

translations.literal: Those under Credential Verification were overseen by the provincial administration commission;
translations.idiomatic: Offices under Credential Verification were led by the provincial administration commission;

sentences.zh: 隸武選者，都指揮領之。

translations.literal: those under Military Selection were overseen by the regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: those under Military Selection were led by the regional commander.

sentences.zh: 於是文武相維，比於中土矣。

translations.literal: Thus civil and military were interlinked, comparable to the central provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military posts were thus interwoven, much as in the heartland.

sentences.zh: 其間叛服不常，誅賞互見。

translations.literal: Among them submission and rebellion were inconstant, punishments and rewards appearing in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Among them loyalty and rebellion shifted without pattern, punishment and reward alternating.

sentences.zh: 茲據其事跡尤著者，列於篇。

translations.literal: Here those whose deeds were especially notable are set forth in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: Here those whose deeds were especially notable are recorded in this chapter.

sentences.zh: ○湖廣土司

translations.literal: ○ Huguang Tribal Headmen
translations.idiomatic: ○ Huguang Tribal Headmen

sentences.zh: 湖南，古巫郡、黔中地也。

translations.literal: Hunan was anciently the land of the Wu commandery and Qianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan was anciently the territory of Wu commandery and Qianzhong.

sentences.zh: 其施州衛與永、保諸土司境，介於嶽、辰、常德之西，與川東巴、夔相接壤，南通黔陽。

translations.literal: The territory of Shizhou Guard and the Yong and Bao tribal headmen lay between Yue, Chen, and Changde to the west, bordered Ba and Kui of eastern Sichuan, and connected south to Qianyang.
translations.idiomatic: The Shizhou Guard and the Yong and Bao headmen lay west of Yue, Chen, and Changde, adjoined Ba and Kui in eastern Sichuan, and reached south to Qianyang.

sentences.zh: 谿峒深阻，易於寇盜，元末滋甚。

translations.literal: Stream valleys and mountain passes were deep and obstructed, easy ground for bandits and raiders, and at the end of Yuan this grew severe.
translations.idiomatic: Deep stream valleys and mountain passes made banditry easy, and troubles worsened at the end of the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 陳友諒據湖、湘間，啖以利，資其兵為用。

translations.literal: Chen Youliang held Hunan and Xiang, enticing them with profit and using their troops.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Youliang held Hunan and the Xiang region, enticing the tribes with profit and employing their soldiers.

sentences.zh: 諸苗亦為盡力，有乞兵旁寨為之驅使者，友諒以此益肆。

translations.literal: The various Miao also exerted themselves to the utmost; some begged troops from neighboring stockades to drive others on — Youliang grew all the more arrogant thereby.
translations.idiomatic: The various Miao fought with all their strength; some even begged troops from neighboring stockades to drive others forward — and Youliang grew bolder still.

sentences.zh: 及太祖殲友諒於鄱陽，進克武昌，湖南諸郡望風歸附，元時所置宣慰、安撫、長官司之屬，皆先後迎降。

translations.literal: When the Taizu destroyed Youliang at Poyang and advanced to take Wuchang, the prefectures of Hunan submitted at the first wind; the pacification, comforting, and chieftain offices set up in Yuan times all came forward to surrender in turn.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizu destroyed Youliang at Poyang and took Wuchang, Hunan's prefectures submitted one after another; the pacification, comforting, and chieftain offices of Yuan times all came forward to surrender in turn.

sentences.zh: 太祖以原官授之，已而梗化。

translations.literal: The Taizu conferred their original offices upon them, yet before long they obstructed transformation.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu confirmed them in their former offices, yet before long they again resisted assimilation.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年，慈利安撫使覃垕連構諸蠻入寇，征南將軍周德興平之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongwu, Cili Comforting Commissioner Qin Huan joined several tribes in raiding; the southern campaign general Zhou Dexing pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 3, Qin Huan, comforting commissioner of Cili, incited several tribes to raid; the southern campaign general Zhou Dexing pacified them.

sentences.zh: 五年，復命鄧愈為征南將軍，率師平散毛等三十六洞，而副將軍吳良復平五開、古州諸蠻凡二百二十三洞，籍其民一萬五千，收集潰散士卒四千五百余人，平其地。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Deng Yu was again appointed southern campaign general and led troops to pacify the thirty-six caves of Sanmao; Vice General Wu Liang also pacified the tribes of Wukai and Guzhou — two hundred twenty-three caves in all — registered fifteen thousand people, gathered more than four thousand five hundred scattered soldiers, and pacified the region.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Deng Yu was again named southern campaign general and pacified the thirty-six caves of Sanmao; Vice General Wu Liang pacified two hundred twenty-three caves among the tribes of Wukai and Guzhou, registered fifteen thousand people, gathered more than four thousand five hundred scattered troops, and secured the region.

sentences.zh: 未幾，五開、五谿諸蠻亂，討平之。

translations.literal: Before long the tribes of Wukai and the Five Streams rebelled and were suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, the tribes of Wukai and the Five Streams rebelled and were put down.

sentences.zh: 十八年，五開蠻吳面兒反，勢獗甚。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Wukai tribesman Wu Mian'er rebelled, and his power was extremely fierce.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Wu Mian'er of the Wukai tribes rebelled with overwhelming force.

sentences.zh: 命楚王楨將征虜將軍湯和，擊斬九谿諸處蠻僚，俘獲四萬余人，諸苗始懼。

translations.literal: The Prince of Chu Zhu Zhen was ordered to lead the expeditionary general Tang He, who struck down the tribal peoples of the Nine Streams and elsewhere, capturing more than forty thousand — only then did the various Miao begin to fear.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Chu Zhu Zhen was ordered to lead expeditionary general Tang He, who struck down the tribal peoples of the Nine Streams and elsewhere and took more than forty thousand captives — only then did the various Miao begin to fear.

sentences.zh: 而靖、沅、道、澧之間，十年內亦尋起尋滅。

translations.literal: Yet between Jing, Yuan, Dao, and Li, within ten years disturbances also rose and fell in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Between Jing, Yuan, Dao, and Li, disturbances likewise flared and subsided within a decade.

sentences.zh: 雖開國之初，師武臣力，實太祖控制之道恩威備焉。

translations.literal: Though at the founding of the state military might and martial ministers did the work, in truth the Taizu's method of control combined kindness and severity in full measure.
translations.idiomatic: Though at the dynasty's founding military force and martial ministers did the work, in truth the Taizu's method combined kindness and severity in full measure.

sentences.zh: 永樂初，苗告繼絕，襲冠帶，益就銜勒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongle the Miao reported broken succession lines and received caps and belts; they submitted ever more readily to the bridle.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Yongle the Miao reported broken succession lines and received caps and belts; they submitted ever more readily to restraint.

sentences.zh: 垂百年，而五開、銅鼓間又紛紛多警。

translations.literal: After nearly a hundred years, alarms again multiplied between Wukai and Tonggu.
translations.idiomatic: After nearly a century, alarms again multiplied between Wukai and Tonggu.

sentences.zh: 時英宗北狩，中原所在侵擾，苗勢殊熾。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yingzong was taken north, the central plain suffered raids everywhere, and Miao power burned especially bright.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yingzong was captured in the north, the heartland was harassed on every side, and Miao strength flared with special intensity.

sentences.zh: 景泰初，總兵官宮聚奏：「蠻賊西至貴州龍裏，東至湖廣沅州，北至武岡，南至播州之境，不下二十萬，圍困焚掠諸郡邑。

translations.literal: Early in Jingtai the regional commander Gong Ju memorialized: "The tribal bandits extend west to Longli in Guizhou, east to Yuanzhou in Huguang, north to Wugang, and south to the borders of Bozhou — no fewer than two hundred thousand — besieging, burning, and plundering prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jingtai regional commander Gong Ju reported: "Tribal rebels range west to Longli in Guizhou, east to Yuanzhou in Huguang, north to Wugang, and south to Bozhou — no fewer than two hundred thousand — besieging and burning prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 臣所領官軍不及二萬，前後奔赴不能解平越之圍。

translations.literal: The government troops I command number fewer than twenty thousand; troops sent before and after could not lift the siege of Pingyue.
translations.idiomatic: The government troops under my command number fewer than twenty thousand; reinforcements sent before and after could not relieve the siege of Pingyue.

sentences.zh: 乞急調京邊軍及征麓川卒十萬前來，以資調遣。

translations.literal: I beg that capital-border troops and the soldiers of the Luchuan campaign — one hundred thousand — be urgently transferred here for deployment.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that capital-border troops and the veterans of the Luchuan campaign — one hundred thousand men — be urgently sent to support operations.

sentences.zh: 」久而師征不至，更易他帥，浸淫六七載。

translations.literal: " Yet troops did not arrive for a long time; commanders were changed, and the affair dragged on six or seven years.
translations.idiomatic: " Yet troops long failed to arrive, commanders were replaced, and the affair dragged on six or seven years.

sentences.zh: 至天順元年，總督石璞調總兵官方瑛，始克期征剿。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianshun, Grand Coordinator Shi Pu mobilized regional commander Fang Ying, and only then was a date set for the punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 1 Grand Coordinator Shi Pu mobilized regional commander Fang Ying, and only then was a date fixed for the punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 破天堂、小坪、墨溪二百二十七寨，擒偽王侯伯等百余人，斬賊首千四百余級，奪回軍人男婦千三百余口，於是苗患漸平。

translations.literal: They broke two hundred twenty-seven stockades at Tiantang, Xiaoping, and Moxi, captured more than a hundred false kings, marquises, and earls, beheaded more than fourteen hundred rebel chiefs, and recovered more than thirteen hundred male and female soldiers and civilians — and so the Miao trouble gradually subsided.
translations.idiomatic: They stormed two hundred twenty-seven stockades at Tiantang, Xiaoping, and Moxi, captured more than a hundred self-styled kings, marquises, and earls, beheaded more than fourteen hundred rebel chiefs, and recovered more than thirteen hundred soldiers and civilians — and the Miao threat gradually eased.

sentences.zh: 蓋萌發於貴州，而蔓銜於湖南，皆生苗為梗。

translations.literal: The trouble had sprouted in Guizhou and spread along vines into Hunan; all were raw Miao causing obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: The trouble had sprouted in Guizhou and spread into Hunan; raw Miao were the source of obstruction throughout.

sentences.zh: 諸土司初無動搖，而永、保諸宣慰，世席富強，每遇征伐，輒願荷戈前驅，國家亦賴以撻伐，故永、保兵號為虓雄。

translations.literal: The tribal headmen at first did not waver, while the Yong and Bao pacification commissioners, wealthy and powerful for generations, whenever campaigns arose were eager to take spear and shield at the van; the state also relied on them for chastisement — hence Yong and Bao troops were called fiercely valiant.
translations.idiomatic: The headmen themselves did not waver at first; the Yong and Bao pacification commissioners, wealthy and powerful for generations, whenever campaigns arose volunteered to lead the van — and the state relied on them for punishment — so Yong and Bao troops were famed as fiercely valiant.

sentences.zh: 嘉、隆以還，徵符四出，而湖南土司均備臂指矣。

translations.literal: From the Jiajing and Longqing reigns onward, summonses went out on every side, and Hunan's tribal headmen all stood ready at the court's finger and thumb.
translations.idiomatic: From the Jiajing and Longqing reigns onward, requisition orders flew in every direction, and Hunan's tribal headmen all stood ready at the court's command.

sentences.zh: △施州

translations.literal: △ Shizhou
translations.idiomatic: △ Shizhou

sentences.zh: （施南宣撫司散毛宣撫司忠建宣撫司容美宣撫司）〉

translations.literal: (Shinan Pacification Superintendent, Sanmao Pacification Superintendent, Zhongjian Pacification Superintendent, Rongmei Pacification Superintendent)
translations.idiomatic: (Shinan Pacification Superintendent; Sanmao Pacification Superintendent; Zhongjian Pacification Superintendent; Rongmei Pacification Superintendent)

sentences.zh: 永順軍民宣慰使司保靖州軍民宣慰使司

translations.literal: Yongshun Military-Civilian Pacification Commissioner; Baojing Prefecture Military-Civilian Pacification Commissioner
translations.idiomatic: Yongshun Military-Civilian Pacification Commissioner; Baojing Prefecture Military-Civilian Pacification Commissioner

sentences.zh: 施州，隋為清江郡，改施州。

translations.literal: Shizhou — under the Sui it was Qingjiang commandery, then renamed Shizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhou: under the Sui it was Qingjiang commandery, later renamed Shizhou.

sentences.zh: 明初仍之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming it remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Ming the name remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 洪武十四年改置施州衛軍民指揮使司，屬湖廣都司。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Hongwu the Shizhou Guard Military-Civilian Command was established, subordinate to the Huguang regional command.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 14 the Shizhou Guard Military-Civilian Command was established, subordinate to the Huguang regional command.

sentences.zh: 領軍民千戶所一：曰大田。

translations.literal: It had one military-civilian battalion: Datian.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw one military-civilian battalion: Datian.

sentences.zh: 領宣撫司三：曰施南，曰散毛，曰忠建。

translations.literal: It had three pacification superintendents: Shinan, Sanmao, and Zhongjian.
translations.idiomatic: It had three pacification superintendents: Shinan, Sanmao, and Zhongjian.

sentences.zh: 領安撫司八：曰東鄉五路，曰忠路，曰忠孝，曰金峒，曰龍潭，曰大旺，曰忠峒，曰高羅。

translations.literal: It had eight comforting commissions: Dongxiang Five Routes, Zhonglu, Zhongxiao, Jintong, Longtan, Dawang, Zhongtong, and Gaoluo.
translations.idiomatic: It had eight comforting commissions: Dongxiang Five Routes, Zhonglu, Zhongxiao, Jintong, Longtan, Dawang, Zhongtong, and Gaoluo.

sentences.zh: 領長官司七：曰搖把峒，曰上愛茶峒，曰下愛茶峒，曰劍南，曰木冊，曰鎮南，曰唐崖。

translations.literal: It had seven chieftain's offices: Yaoba Cave, Upper Ai Tea Cave, Lower Ai Tea Cave, Jiannan, Muce, Zhennan, and Tangya.
translations.idiomatic: It had seven chieftain's offices: Yaoba Cave, Upper Ai Tea Cave, Lower Ai Tea Cave, Jiannan, Muce, Zhennan, and Tangya.

sentences.zh: 領蠻夷長官司五：曰鎮遠，曰隆奉，曰西泙，曰東流，曰臘壁峒。

translations.literal: It had five tribal chieftain's offices: Zhenyuan, Longfeng, Xiping, Dongliu, and Labi Cave.
translations.idiomatic: It had five tribal chieftain's offices: Zhenyuan, Longfeng, Xiping, Dongliu, and Labi Cave.

sentences.zh: 又有容美宣撫司者，亦在境內，領長官司四：曰椒山瑪瑙，曰五峰石寶，曰石梁下峒，曰水盡源通塔平。

translations.literal: There was also the Rongmei Pacification Superintendent within the territory, with four chieftain's offices: Jiaoshan Agate, Wufeng Shibao, Shiliang Xiadong, and Shuijinyuan Tongtapin.
translations.idiomatic: The Rongmei Pacification Superintendent also lay within the territory, with four chieftain's offices: Jiaoshan Agate, Wufeng Shibao, Shiliang Xiadong, and Shuijinyuan Tongtapin.

sentences.zh: 初，太祖即吳王位，甲辰六月，湖廣安定宣撫使向思明遣長官硬徹律等，以元所授宣撫敕印來上，請改授。

translations.literal: At first, when the Taizu took the title King of Wu, in the sixth month of jiachen the Huguang Anding Pacification Commissioner Xiang Siming sent chieftain Ying Chelü and others to present the Yuan-conferred pacification patent and seal, requesting reappointment.
translations.idiomatic: Early on, when the Taizu took the title King of Wu, in the sixth month, jiachen cycle, Huguang Anding Pacification Commissioner Xiang Siming sent chieftain Ying Chelü and others to present the Yuan-conferred pacification patent and seal and request reappointment.

sentences.zh: 乃命仍置安定等處宣撫司二，以思明及其弟思勝為之。

translations.literal: He then ordered that two Anding and other pacification superintendents be retained, with Siming and his younger brother Sisheng appointed.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered two Anding and related pacification superintendents retained, appointing Siming and his younger brother Sisheng.

sentences.zh: 又置懷德軍民宣撫司一，以向大旺為之，統軍元帥二，以南木、潘仲玉為之。

translations.literal: He also established one Huaide Military-Civilian Pacification Superintendent, with Xiang Dawang appointed, and two army marshals — Nanmu and Pan Zhongyu.
translations.idiomatic: He also established one Huaide Military-Civilian Pacification Superintendent under Xiang Dawang, with two army marshals — Nanmu and Pan Zhongyu.

sentences.zh: 抽攔、不用、黃石三洞，各置長官一，以沒葉、大蟲、硬徹律為之。

translations.literal: For the three caves of Choulian, Buyong, and Huangshi he placed one chieftain each — Meiye, Dachong, and Ying Chelü.
translations.idiomatic: For the three caves Choulian, Buyong, and Huangshi he appointed one chieftain each — Meiye, Dachong, and Ying Chelü.

sentences.zh: 簳坪洞設元帥府一，以向顯祖為之。

translations.literal: For Qianping Cave he established one marshal's headquarters, with Xiang Xianzu in charge.
translations.idiomatic: For Qianping Cave he established one marshal's headquarters under Xiang Xianzu.

sentences.zh: 梅梓、麻寮二洞，各置長官一，以向思明、唐漢明為之。

translations.literal: For Meizi and Maliao caves he placed one chieftain each — Xiang Siming and Tang Hanming.
translations.idiomatic: For Meizi and Maliao caves he placed one chieftain each — Xiang Siming and Tang Hanming.

sentences.zh: 皆新降者。

translations.literal: All were newly submitted.
translations.idiomatic: All were newly submitted peoples.

sentences.zh: 丙午二月，容美洞宣撫使田光寶遣弟光受等，以元所授宣撫敕印來上。

translations.literal: In the second month of bingwu, Rongmei Cave Pacification Commissioner Tian Guangbao sent his younger brother Guangshou and others to present the Yuan-conferred pacification patent and seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, bingwu cycle, Rongmei Cave Pacification Commissioner Tian Guangbao sent his younger brother Guangshou and others to present the Yuan-conferred pacification patent and seal.

sentences.zh: 命光寶為四川行省參政，行容美洞等處軍民宣撫司事，仍置安撫元帥治之。

translations.literal: Guangbao was appointed Sichuan Branch Secretariat councillor and charged with the Rongmei Cave Military-Civilian Pacification Superintendent; comforting marshals were still placed to govern.
translations.idiomatic: Guangbao was named Sichuan Branch Secretariat councillor and charged with the Rongmei Cave Military-Civilian Pacification Superintendent, with comforting marshals still appointed to govern.

sentences.zh: 並立太平、臺宜、麻寮等十寨長官司。

translations.literal: Ten stockade chieftain's offices were also established at Taiping, Taiyi, Maliao, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Ten stockade chieftain's offices were also established at Taiping, Taiyi, Maliao, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 洪武四年，宣寧侯曹良臣帥兵取桑植，容美洞元施南道宣慰使覃大勝弟大旺、副宣慰覃大興、光寶子答谷等皆來朝，納元所授金虎符。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Hongwu, Marquis Cao Liangchen led troops to take Sangzhi; Tian Guangbao's son Daguo of Rongmei Cave, Qin Dawang younger brother of Yuan Shinan Circuit Pacification Commissioner Qin Dasheng, Vice Pacification Commissioner Qin Daxing, and others all came to court and surrendered the Yuan golden tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 4, Marquis Cao Liangchen led troops to take Sangzhi; Tian Guangbao's son Daguo of Rongmei Cave, Qin Dawang younger brother of Yuan Shinan Circuit Pacification Commissioner Qin Dasheng, Vice Pacification Commissioner Qin Daxing, and others all came to court and surrendered the Yuan golden tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 命以施州宣慰司為從三品，東鄉諸長官司為正六品，以流官參用。

translations.literal: The Shizhou Pacification Commission was made third rank subordinate, Dongxiang chieftain's offices were made sixth rank, and regular officials were intermixed.
translations.idiomatic: The Shizhou Pacification Commission was made third rank subordinate; Dongxiang chieftain's offices were made sixth rank, with regular officials intermixed.

sentences.zh: 五年，忠建元帥墨池遣其子驢吾，率所部溪洞元帥阿巨等來歸附，納元所授金虎符並銀印、銅章、誥敕。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Zhongjian Marshal Mochi sent his son Lüwu leading stream-cave marshals Agu and others to submit, surrendering the Yuan golden tiger tally together with silver seals, bronze stamps, and patents.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Zhongjian Marshal Mochi sent his son Lüwu leading stream-cave marshals Agu and others to submit, surrendering the Yuan golden tiger tally with silver seals, bronze stamps, and patents.

sentences.zh: 置忠建長官司及沿邊溪洞長官司，以墨池等為長官。

translations.literal: The Zhongjian Chieftain's Office and border stream-cave chieftain's offices were established, with Mochi and others as chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhongjian Chieftain's Office and border stream-cave chieftain's offices were established, with Mochi and others as chieftains.

sentences.zh: 二月，容美宣撫田光寶復遣子答谷來朝。

translations.literal: In the second month Tian Guangbao of Rongmei Pacification again sent his son Daguo to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Tian Guangbao of Rongmei Pacification again sent his son Daguo to court.

sentences.zh: 征南將軍鄧愈平散毛、柿谿、赤谿、安福等三十九峒，散毛宣慰司都元帥覃野旺上偽夏所授印。

translations.literal: Southern campaign general Deng Yu pacified the thirty-nine caves of Sanmao, Shixi, Chixi, and Anfu; Sanmao Pacification Commission Grand Marshal Qin Yewang surrendered the seal conferred by the false Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Southern campaign general Deng Yu pacified thirty-nine caves including Sanmao, Shixi, Chixi, and Anfu; Sanmao Pacification Commission Grand Marshal Qin Yewang surrendered the seal conferred by the false Xia.

sentences.zh: 十四年，江夏侯周德興移師討水盡源、通塔平、散毛諸峒，置施州衛軍民指揮使司。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Marquis Zhou Dexing of Jiangxia shifted troops to attack the caves of Shuijinyuan, Tongtapin, and Sanmao and established the Shizhou Guard Military-Civilian Command.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Marquis Zhou Dexing of Jiangxia moved troops against the caves of Shuijinyuan, Tongtapin, and Sanmao and established the Shizhou Guard Military-Civilian Command.

sentences.zh: 十五年，置施南宣撫司，隸施州衛。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the Shinan Pacification Superintendent was established, subordinate to Shizhou Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year the Shinan Pacification Superintendent was established, subordinate to Shizhou Guard.

sentences.zh: 十七年，散毛、沿邊安撫司安撫覃野旺之子起剌來朝，命為本司僉事。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Qici, son of Sanmao and border comforting commissioner Qin Yewang, came to court and was appointed vice commissioner of his office.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Qici, son of Sanmao and border comforting commissioner Qin Yewang, came to court and was appointed vice commissioner of his office.

sentences.zh: 景川侯曹震言：「散毛等洞蠻時寇掠為民患，已令施州衛及施南宣撫覃大勝招之，如負固，請發兵討。」

translations.literal: Marquis Cao Zhen of Jingchuan said: "The tribes of Sanmao and other caves often raid and are a plague to the people; Shizhou Guard and Shinan Pacification Superintendent Qin Dasheng have been ordered to summon them — if they resist, please send troops to punish."
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Cao Zhen of Jingchuan reported: "Tribes of Sanmao and other caves often raid and plague the people; Shizhou Guard and Shinan Pacification Superintendent Qin Dasheng have been ordered to summon them — if they hold out, send troops to punish them."

sentences.zh: 二十二年命忠建宣撫田思進之子忠孝代父職。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year Zhongxiao, son of Zhongjian Pacification Superintendent Tian Sijin, was ordered to replace his father.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year Zhongxiao, son of Zhongjian Pacification Superintendent Tian Sijin, was ordered to replace his father.

sentences.zh: 時思進年八十余，乞致仕，故有是命。

translations.literal: At the time Sijin was over eighty and begged to retire — hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: Sijin was then over eighty and begged to retire — hence the order.

sentences.zh: 明年，涼國公藍玉克散毛洞，擒剌惹長官覃大旺等萬余人。

translations.literal: The next year Duke Lan Yu of Liang took Sanmao Cave and captured more than ten thousand including Lare Chieftain Qin Dawang.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Duke Lan Yu of Liang took Sanmao Cave and captured more than ten thousand including Lare Chieftain Qin Dawang.

sentences.zh: 置大田軍民千戶所，隸施州衛。

translations.literal: The Datian Military-Civilian Battalion was established, subordinate to Shizhou Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The Datian Military-Civilian Battalion was established, subordinate to Shizhou Guard.

sentences.zh: 以藍玉奏散毛、鎮南、大旺、施南等洞蠻叛服不常，黔江、施州衛兵相去遠，難應援。

translations.literal: Lan Yu reported that the tribes of Sanmao, Zhennan, Dawang, Shinan, and other caves were inconstant in submission and rebellion; Qianjiang and Shizhou Guard troops were far apart and hard to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Yu reported that tribes of Sanmao, Zhennan, Dawang, Shinan, and other caves wavered between submission and rebellion; Qianjiang and Shizhou Guard troops were too far apart to reinforce one another readily.

sentences.zh: 今散毛地與大水田連，宜置千戶所守禦，乃改散毛為大田，命千戶石山等領土兵一千五百人，置所鎮之。

translations.literal: Now Sanmao territory adjoined Dashuitian; a battalion should guard it — Sanmao was therefore changed to Datian, and Battalion Commander Shi Shan and others were ordered to lead fifteen hundred native troops to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: Sanmao territory now adjoined Dashuitian; a battalion should guard it — Sanmao was renamed Datian, and Battalion Commander Shi Shan and others were ordered to lead fifteen hundred native troops to garrison the post.

sentences.zh: 時忠建、施南叛蠻結寨於龍孔，玉遣指揮徐玉將兵攻之，擒宣撫覃大勝，余蠻退走。

translations.literal: At the time rebellious tribes of Zhongjian and Shinan had fortified stockades at Longkong; Yu sent Commander Xu Yu with troops to attack, captured Pacification Superintendent Qin Dasheng, and the remaining tribes fled.
translations.idiomatic: Rebellious tribes of Zhongjian and Shinan had fortified stockades at Longkong; Yu sent Commander Xu Yu to attack, captured Pacification Superintendent Qin Dasheng, and the rest fled.

sentences.zh: 玉復分兵搜之，殺獲男女一千八百余人，械大勝及其黨八百二十人送京師。

translations.literal: Yu again divided troops to search them out, killing and capturing more than eighteen hundred men and women, and sent Dasheng and more than eight hundred twenty of his followers to the capital in bonds.
translations.idiomatic: Yu again divided his forces to hunt them down, killing and capturing more than eighteen hundred men and women, and sent Dasheng and more than eight hundred twenty followers to the capital in bonds.

sentences.zh: 磔大勝於市，余戍開元，給衣糧遣之。

translations.literal: Dasheng was dismembered in the market; the rest were exiled to Kaiyuan with clothing and grain provided for the journey.
translations.idiomatic: Dasheng was dismembered in the market; the rest were exiled to Kaiyuan with clothing and grain for the journey.

sentences.zh: 永樂二年復設散毛、施南二長官司。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongle the Sanmao and Shinan chieftain's offices were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 2 the Sanmao and Shinan chieftain's offices were re-established.

sentences.zh: 先是，洪武初，諸土司長官來降者，皆予原官。

translations.literal: Earlier, at the beginning of Hongwu, tribal headmen who came to submit were all given their original offices.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, at the beginning of Hongwu, headmen who submitted were all confirmed in their former offices.

sentences.zh: 蠻苗吳面兒之難，諸土司地多荒廢，長官亦罷承襲。

translations.literal: During the troubles of the Miao Wu Mian'er, many headman territories lay waste and succession of chieftains was also suspended.
translations.idiomatic: During the troubles of the Miao leader Wu Mian'er, many headman territories fell waste and succession was suspended.

sentences.zh: 至是，故土官之子覃友諒等以招復蠻民，請仍設治所。

translations.literal: Now the sons of former native officials, Qin Youliang and others, having gathered tribal peoples, requested that governing posts be re-established.
translations.idiomatic: Now sons of former native officials such as Qin Youliang, having gathered tribal peoples back, asked that governing posts be restored.

sentences.zh: 以其戶少，降為長官司，隸大田軍民千戶所。

translations.literal: Because their households were few, they were reduced to chieftain's offices, subordinate to the Datian Military-Civilian Battalion.
translations.idiomatic: Because their registered households were few, the offices were reduced to chieftain's rank and placed under the Datian Military-Civilian Battalion.

sentences.zh: 以友諒為散毛，長官，覃添富為施南長官。

translations.literal: Youliang was made Sanmao chieftain; Tian Tianfu was made Shinan chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Youliang was appointed Sanmao chieftain and Qin Tianfu Shinan chieftain.

sentences.zh: 四年，改施南、散毛仍為宣撫司，以友諒、添富來朝故也。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Shinan and Sanmao were again made pacification superintendents, because Youliang and Tianfu had come to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Shinan and Sanmao were restored to pacification superintendents because Youliang and Tianfu had presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 以田應虎為龍潭安撫。

translations.literal: Tian Yinghu was made Longtan comforting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Yinghu was appointed comforting commissioner of Longtan.

sentences.zh: 時應虎來朝，言其祖父自宋、元來，俱為安撫，自蠻亂並其地入散毛隔遠難治，乞仍舊，從之。

translations.literal: At the time Yinghu came to court and said that his grandfather's line from Song and Yuan times had all been comforting commissioners; since the tribal troubles their territory had been merged into Sanmao, and the distance made governance hard — he begged restoration as before, and it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: When Yinghu came to court he said his forebears had held comforting office since Song and Yuan times, but tribal unrest had merged their lands into Sanmao, which was too remote to govern — he asked for the old arrangement, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 時高羅安撫田大民言，招復蠻民四百余戶，乞還原職治所。

translations.literal: At the time Gaoluo comforting commissioner Tian Damin reported that he had gathered back more than four hundred tribal households and begged return to his original post and seat of government.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Tian Damin of Gaoluo reported that he had brought back more than four hundred tribal households and asked to resume his former office and seat.

sentences.zh: 木冊長官田谷佐、唐崖長官覃忠孝，並言父祖世為安撫，洪武時大軍平蜀，民驚潰，治所廢，今谷佐等招集三百余戶，請襲，許之。

translations.literal: Muce Chieftain Tian Guzuo and Tangya Chieftain Qin Zhongxiao both said that their fathers and grandfathers had for generations been comforting commissioners; when Hongwu armies pacified Shu the people fled in panic and government seats were abandoned — now Guzuo and others had gathered more than three hundred households and requested succession; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Muce chieftain Tian Guzuo and Tangya chieftain Qin Zhongxiao both said their line had held comforting office for generations until Hongwu's conquest of Shu scattered the people and ruined their seats — now they had gathered more than three hundred households and sought succession, which was granted.

sentences.zh: 五年，鎮南長官覃興等來朝，稱系世職，洪武中廢，今招來蠻民三百戶，乞仍舊，既五峰石寶長官張再武亦以襲職請，從之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Zhennan chieftain Qin Xing and others came to court, claiming hereditary office abolished in Hongwu; now they had gathered three hundred tribal households and begged restoration — and Wufeng Shibao chieftain Zhang Zaiwu also requested succession; all were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Qin Xing of Zhennan and others came to court, claiming hereditary posts abolished under Hongwu; having gathered three hundred tribal households they asked for restoration — and Zhang Zaiwu of Wufeng Shibao also sought succession; the court agreed to both.

sentences.zh: 同時，設東鄉五路安撫，以覃忠為之，隸施南。

translations.literal: At the same time the Dongxiang Five Routes comforting commission was established, with Qin Zhong appointed, subordinate to Shinan.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time the Dongxiang Five Routes comforting commission was set up under Qin Zhong, subordinate to Shinan.

sentences.zh: 設石梁下峒、椒山瑪瑙、水盡源通塔平三長官司，以向潮文、劉再貴、唐思文為之，隸容美。

translations.literal: Three chieftain's offices were established at Shiliang Xiadong, Jiaoshan Agate, and Shuijinyuan Tongtapin, with Xiang Chaowen, Liu Zaigui, and Tang Siwen appointed, subordinate to Rongmei.
translations.idiomatic: Chieftain's offices were established at Shiliang Xiadong, Jiaoshan Agate, and Shuijinyuan Tongtapin, with Xiang Chaowen, Liu Zaigui, and Tang Siwen in charge under Rongmei.

sentences.zh: 既復設忠路、忠孝、金峒三安撫司，隸施州衛，以覃英、田大英、覃添貴為之。

translations.literal: The three comforting commissions of Zhonglu, Zhongxiao, and Jintong were also re-established, subordinate to Shizhou Guard, with Qin Ying, Tian Daying, and Qin Tiangui appointed.
translations.idiomatic: The comforting commissions of Zhonglu, Zhongxiao, and Jintong were re-established under Shizhou Guard, with Qin Ying, Tian Daying, and Qin Tiangui appointed.

sentences.zh: 皆因洪武間蠻亂民散，廢其治，今忠等以故官子侄來朝，奏請復設，並從之，各賜印章冠帶。

translations.literal: All were because during Hongwu tribal troubles had scattered the people and government was abandoned; now Zhong and others, as sons and nephews of former officials, came to court requesting re-establishment — all were granted, each receiving seals, caps, and belts.
translations.idiomatic: All this followed Hongwu-era unrest that had scattered the people and ended local rule; now Zhong and others, as heirs of former officials, came to court to ask for restoration — the court agreed and bestowed seals, caps, and belts on each.

sentences.zh: 宣德二年設劍南長官司，隸忠路安撫；

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuande the Jiannan chieftain's office was established, subordinate to Zhonglu comforting commission;
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 2 the Jiannan chieftain's office was created, subordinate to Zhonglu comforting commission;

sentences.zh: 搖把峒、上愛下愛二茶峒三長官司及鎮邊、隆奉二蠻夷官司，皆隸東鄉五路安撫；

translations.literal: the three chieftain's offices of Yaoba Cave and the Upper and Lower Ai Tea Caves and the two tribal offices of Zhenbian and Longfeng were all subordinate to Dongxiang Five Routes comforting commission;
translations.idiomatic: the chieftain's offices of Yaoba Cave and the Upper and Lower Ai Tea Caves and the tribal offices of Zhenbian and Longfeng were placed under Dongxiang Five Routes;

sentences.zh: 東流、臘壁峒二蠻夷官司，隸散毛宣撫；

translations.literal: the two tribal offices of Dongliu and Labi Cave were subordinate to Sanmao pacification superintendent;
translations.idiomatic: the tribal offices of Dongliu and Labi Cave were placed under Sanmao pacification superintendent;

sentences.zh: 石關峒長官司、西泙蠻夷官司，隸金峒安撫。

translations.literal: the Shiguan Cave chieftain's office and the Xiping tribal office were subordinate to Jintong comforting commission.
translations.idiomatic: the Shiguan Cave chieftain's office and the Xiping tribal office were placed under Jintong comforting commission.

sentences.zh: 皆以其酋長為之。

translations.literal: In every case their tribal chiefs were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In each case the tribal chiefs themselves were appointed.

sentences.zh: 先是，忠路安撫司等各奏，前元故土官子孫牟酋蠻等，各擁蠻民，久據谿洞，今就招撫，請設官司，授以職事。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Zhonglu comforting commission and others had memorialized that descendants of former Yuan native officials such as Mou Qiu and other tribesmen each held tribal peoples and had long occupied stream valleys and mountain passes; now having submitted to pacification, they requested offices be established and duties conferred.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Zhonglu and other offices had reported that Yuan-era native heirs such as Mou Qiu still held tribal followers and long occupied mountain passes; now pacified, they asked for formal offices and titles.

sentences.zh: 兵部以聞，帝以馭蠻當順其情，所授諸司，宜有等殺。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War reported this; the emperor held that governing tribes should follow their inclinations, and the offices granted should have graded ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War relayed the matter; the emperor said tribes should be governed according to their customs, and the offices granted should be ranked in proper order.

sentences.zh: 兵部議以四百戶以上者設長官司，四百戶以下者設蠻夷官司。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War proposed that where households numbered four hundred or more a chieftain's office should be set up, and where fewer than four hundred a tribal chieftain's office.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry proposed chieftain's offices for groups of four hundred households or more and tribal chieftain's offices for fewer than four hundred.

sentences.zh: 元土官子孫量授以職，從所招官司管屬。

translations.literal: Descendants of Yuan native officials were to be given offices according to merit, under the supervising offices that had recruited them.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan native heirs were to receive posts commensurate with their standing, under whichever recruiting office had brought them in.

sentences.zh: 皆從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved all of this.

sentences.zh: 令三年一朝貢如故事。

translations.literal: They were ordered to present tribute at court once every three years as of old.
translations.idiomatic: They were ordered to send triennial tribute missions as in former practice.

sentences.zh: 九年，木冊長官田谷佐奏：「高羅安撫常倚勢淩轢，侵奪其土地人民，已蒙朝廷分理，然彼宿怨未平，恐復加害。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Muce chieftain Tian Guzuo memorialized: "The Gaoluo comforting commissioner constantly relies on power to bully and oppress, seizing our land and people; though the court has already adjudicated, old enmity is not settled and we fear further harm.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Tian Guzuo of Muce reported: "The Gaoluo comforting commissioner habitually abuses his power, seizing our lands and people; though the court has ruled on the dispute, old hatred remains and we fear further injury.

sentences.zh: 乞徑隸施州衛。

translations.literal: We beg to be placed directly under Shizhou Guard."
translations.idiomatic: We ask to be placed directly under Shizhou Guard."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 正統三年命散毛宣撫覃友諒子瑄試職。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhengtong the Sanmao pacification superintendent's son Qin Xuan was ordered to trial appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 3 Qin Xuan, son of Sanmao pacification superintendent Qin Youliang, was given trial appointment.

sentences.zh: 初，友諒以罪械赴京，中路逃匿，後為官軍所獲，斃獄。

translations.literal: Earlier, Youliang had been shackled and sent to the capital for crime, escaped midway, and was later captured by government troops and died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Youliang had been sent to the capital in bonds for crime, escaped en route, was later captured by government troops, and died in prison.

sentences.zh: 至是，本司以其子為蠻民信服，乞襲職。

translations.literal: Now the office reported that his son was trusted by the tribal people and begged succession.
translations.idiomatic: Now the office reported that his son enjoyed the tribes' trust and asked for succession.

sentences.zh: 帝以友諒罪重宜革，第以蠻故詘法信恩，命瑄試職圖後效。

translations.literal: The emperor held that Youliang's crimes were grave and the post should be abolished, but because of the tribes bent the law in favor of mercy and ordered Xuan to trial appointment to see later results.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said Youliang's crimes warranted abolition of the line, yet because of tribal custom bent the law in mercy and let Xuan serve on trial to prove himself.

sentences.zh: 景泰二年，禮部奏：「散毛宣撫司副使黃縉瑄謀殺親兄，律應斬。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingtai the Ministry of Rites memorialized: "Sanmao Pacification Superintendent Vice Commissioner Huang Jin Xuan plotted to kill his elder brother; by law he should be beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai 2 the Ministry of Rites reported: "Huang Jin Xuan, vice commissioner of Sanmao Pacification Superintendent, plotted to murder his elder brother and should be beheaded by law.

sentences.zh: 其妻譚氏遣子忠等貢馬贖罪，然縉瑄罪重，法不可宥。

translations.literal: His wife Lady Tan sent their son Zhong and others to present horses to redeem guilt, yet Jin Xuan's crime was grave and the law could not pardon.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Lady Tan sent their son Zhong and others with horses to redeem his guilt, but the crime was too grave to pardon.

sentences.zh: 宜給鈔以酬馬直。

translations.literal: Paper money should be given in compensation for the horses' value.
translations.idiomatic: Paper money should be given in compensation for the horses.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry's recommendation was approved.

sentences.zh: 天順元年，容美宣撫田潮美老疾，請子保富代職，從之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianshun Rongmei pacification superintendent Tian Chaomei, old and ill, asked that his son Baofu replace him — and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 1 Tian Chaomei of Rongmei, aged and ill, asked that his son Baofu succeed him, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 五年，禮部奏：「施州木冊長官司土舍譚文壽兇暴，並造不法誹謗之言，罪當刑。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the Ministry of Rites memorialized: "Shizhou Muce chieftain's office native cadet Tan Wenshou is violent and has even uttered unlawful slander — the crime warrants punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Ministry of Rites reported: "Tan Wenshou, native cadet of Shizhou's Muce chieftain's office, is violent and has spoken unlawful slander — he should be punished.

sentences.zh: 今其母向氏進馬以贖，恐不可從。

translations.literal: Now his mother Lady Xiang presents horses to redeem him — this perhaps should not be accepted.
translations.idiomatic: His mother Lady Xiang now offers horses to redeem him, which perhaps should not be allowed.

sentences.zh: 」帝命給鈔百錠以慰其母，其子仍禁錮之。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered one hundred ingots of paper money given to comfort his mother; the son was still imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered one hundred ingots of paper money to comfort the mother while the son remained imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 成化二年，搖把洞長官向麥答踵奏：「鄰近洗羅峒長，窺知本洞土兵調征兩廣，村寨空虛，煽誘土蠻攻劫，乞調官軍剿治。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chenghua Yaoba Cave chieftain Xiang Maidazhong memorialized: "The neighboring Xiluo Cave chieftain, seeing that this cave's native troops had been mobilized for the Two Guangs campaign and stockades left empty, incited native tribesmen to raid — we beg government troops be sent to suppress."
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 2 Xiang Maidazhong of Yaoba Cave reported: "The neighboring Xiluo chieftain, learning our native troops had been sent to the Two Guangs and our stockades left empty, incited raiders — we beg government troops for suppression."

sentences.zh: 」五年，禮部奏：「容美宣撫司田保富等，遣人進貢方物不及數，恐使者侵盜，宜停其賞，仍移知所司。

translations.literal: " In the fifth year the Ministry of Rites memorialized: "Rongmei Pacification Superintendent Tian Baofu and others sent men to present tribute goods short of the required amount — fearing the envoys embezzled them, rewards should be withheld and the responsible offices informed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Ministry of Rites reported: "Tian Baofu of Rongmei and others sent tribute below the required quota — fearing the envoys stole the goods, rewards should be withheld and local offices informed.

sentences.zh: 」施州等衛八安撫司各奏，成化五年朝覲進馬，已付邊衛騎操，而諸衛收馬文移不至，恐有虛詐，宜勘實給賞，皆從之。

translations.literal: " The eight comforting commissions of Shizhou Guard and others each memorialized that for the Chenghua 5 court audience they had presented horses already handed to border guards for training, yet the receipt documents from the various guards had not arrived — fearing fraud, verification should be made before rewards — all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: The eight comforting commissions under Shizhou Guard and elsewhere reported that horses presented for the Chenghua 5 audience had been sent to border guards for training, but receipts had not arrived — fearing fraud, rewards should follow verification — and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 弘治二年，木冊長官田賢及容美致在田保富各進馬，為土人譚敬保等贖罪。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongzhi Muce chieftain Tian Xian and Tian Baofu, retired from Rongmei, each presented horses to redeem the native Tan Jingbao and others.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi 2 Tian Xian of Muce and the retired Tian Baofu of Rongmei each presented horses to redeem Tan Jingbao and other natives.

sentences.zh: 刑部言：「蠻民納馬贖罪，輕者可原，重者難宥，宜下按臣察核。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Punishments said: "When tribesmen present horses to redeem crimes, light offenses may be pardoned but grave ones are hard to excuse — investigation should be delegated to the touring censor.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Punishments said: "Tribal horse offerings may redeem light crimes but not grave ones — touring officials should investigate."

sentences.zh: 」八年，容美宣撫貢馬及香，禮部以香不及數，馬多道斃，又無文驗，命予半賞。

translations.literal: " In the eighth year Rongmei pacification superintendent presented horses and incense; the Ministry of Rites, because the incense fell short and many horses died on the road with no verification documents, ordered half rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Rongmei presented horses and incense; the Ministry of Rites, finding the incense short, many horses dead on the road, and no verification papers, ordered half rewards.

sentences.zh: 九年，金峒安撫覃彥龍奏：「境內產杉木，嘗鬻金三千貯庫。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Jintong comforting commissioner Qin Yanlong memorialized: "Within our territory fir timber is produced; three thousand taels of gold from sales were once stored in the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Qin Yanlong of Jintong reported: "Our territory produces fir; three thousand taels from sales were once stored in the treasury.

sentences.zh: 今彥龍年老，子惟一人，恐身後土人爭奪，乞解部。

translations.literal: Now Yanlong is old and has only one son — fearing that after his death the natives will fight over it, we beg it be surrendered to the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Now I am old with only one son — fearing strife among the natives after my death, I ask that it be surrendered to the ministry."

sentences.zh: 」工部議非貢典，卻之。

translations.literal: " The Ministry of Works held this was not within tribute regulations and refused it.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Works ruled this outside tribute regulations and refused.

sentences.zh: 正德四年，容美宣撫並椒山瑪瑙長官司所遣通事劉思朝等赴京進貢，沿途驛傳多需索，為偵事所發，自魯橋以北計千余金。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhengde the Rongmei pacification superintendent and the Jiaoshan Agate chieftain's office sent interpreters Liu Sichao and others to the capital with tribute; along the route they made many demands on the courier stations — exposed by investigators, from north of Luqiao alone the sum exceeded one thousand taels of gold.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 4 Rongmei and Jiaoshan Agate sent interpreters Liu Sichao and others to court with tribute; along the route they extorted the courier stations — exposed by investigators, their take north of Luqiao alone exceeded one thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 部臣以聞，帝以遠蠻宥之。

translations.literal: The ministry reported this; the emperor pardoned them as distant tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry reported this; the emperor pardoned them as distant tribes.

sentences.zh: 散毛宣撫並五峰石寶、水盡源通塔平長官司入貢後期，部議半賞，從之。

translations.literal: The Sanmao pacification superintendent and the chieftain's offices of Wufeng Shibao and Shuijinyuan Tongtapin presented tribute late; the ministry proposed half rewards — approved.
translations.idiomatic: Sanmao pacification superintendent and the chieftain's offices of Wufeng Shibao and Shuijinyuan Tongtapin arrived late with tribute; the ministry proposed half rewards, which were granted.

sentences.zh: 九年命大田千戶所千戶冉霖彡子舜卿為指揮僉事，以自陳討川寇功也。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Battalion Commander Shunqing, son of Datian Battalion Commander Ran Linshan, was made assistant regional commander for reporting merit in suppressing Sichuan bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Shunqing, son of Datian battalion commander Ran Linshan, was made assistant regional commander for merit against Sichuan bandits.

sentences.zh: 十一年，容美宣撫田秀愛其幼子，將逐其兄白俚俾，而以幼子襲。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Rongmei pacification superintendent Tian Xiu favored his young son and was about to drive out his elder brother Bailübi and let the young son succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Tian Xiu of Rongmei favored a younger son and planned to drive out his elder brother Bailübi so the younger could succeed.

sentences.zh: 白俚俾恨之，賊殺其父及其弟。

translations.literal: Bailübi hated this and murdered his father and younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Bailübi, enraged, murdered his father and younger brother.

sentences.zh: 事聞，下鎮巡官驗治，磔死。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, regional inspection officials were sent to investigate; he was dismembered in execution.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, touring officials investigated and he was dismembered.

sentences.zh: 土官唐勝富、張世英等為白俚俾奏辨，罪亦當坐。

translations.literal: Native officials Tang Shengfu, Zhang Shiying, and others memorialized in Bailübi's defense — they too were liable by law.
translations.idiomatic: Native officials Tang Shengfu and Zhang Shiying and others pleaded Bailübi's case — they too were legally liable.

sentences.zh: 詔以蠻僚異類，難盡繩以法，免其並坐，戒飭之。

translations.literal: An edict held that as tribal peoples of a different kind, it was hard to bind them fully by law — they were exempted from joint punishment and admonished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict held that as tribal peoples of another kind they could not be fully bound by statute — they were exempted from joint punishment and admonished.

sentences.zh: 十五年，容美宣撫司同知田世瑛，奏獲鎮南軍民府古印，為始祖田始進開熙二年頒給，乞改升宣撫司為軍民府。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Rongmei Pacification Superintendent Vice Commissioner Tian Shiying memorialized that he had obtained the ancient seal of Zhennan Military-Civilian Prefecture, issued in the second year of Kaixi under founder Tian Shi — and begged that the pacification superintendent's office be raised to a military-civilian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year vice commissioner Tian Shiying of Rongmei reported recovering the ancient seal of Zhennan Military-Civilian Prefecture, issued in Kaixi 2 to founder Tian Shi, and asked that the pacification office be raised to a military-civilian prefecture.

sentences.zh: 禮部議，以開設宣撫，頒印已久，不當更，古印宜繳，從之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites deliberated: since the pacification superintendent had long been established and its seal issued, it should not be changed; the ancient seal should be surrendered — approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites ruled that the pacification office and its seal had long been established and should not be changed; the ancient seal should be surrendered — approved.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖七年，容美宣撫司、龍潭安撫司每朝貢率領千人，所過擾害，鳳陽巡撫唐龍以聞。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing the Rongmei Pacification Superintendent and Longtan Comforting Commission each led a thousand men on tribute missions, harming the regions they passed — Huguang grand coordinator Tang Long reported this.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 7 Rongmei pacification superintendent and Longtan comforting commission each led a thousand men on tribute missions, harming the regions they passed — grand coordinator Tang Long of Huguang reported it.

sentences.zh: 禮部按舊制，進貢不過百人，赴京不過二十人，命所司申飭。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites, according to old regulations that tribute parties should not exceed one hundred men and no more than twenty should go to the capital, ordered the responsible offices to admonish them.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites, citing the old limit of one hundred for tribute parties and twenty for the capital journey, ordered local offices to admonish them.

sentences.zh: 忠孝安撫司把事田春者數十人稱入貢，偽造關文，騷擾驛傳，應天巡撫以聞。

translations.literal: Several dozen men of Zhongxiao Comforting Commission clerk Tian Chun claimed to be going on tribute, forged transit documents, and harassed courier stations — the grand coordinator of Yingtian reported this.
translations.idiomatic: Several dozen men led by clerk Tian Chun of Zhongxiao comforting commission claimed tribute missions, forged transit papers, and harassed courier stations — the Yingtian grand coordinator reported it.

sentences.zh: 兵部議，土司違例入貢，且所過橫索，恐有他虞，宜嚴禁諭。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War deliberated: tribal headmen entering tribute against regulations and extorting along the way might portend other trouble — strict prohibition and warning should be issued.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War proposed that headmen entering tribute against regulations while extorting along the route might portend further trouble — strict prohibition was needed.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，臘壁峒等長官司入貢，禮部驗印文詐偽，詔革其賞，並下按臣勘問。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Labi Cave and other chieftain's offices presented tribute; the Ministry of Rites verified the seals and documents as forged — an edict stripped their rewards and ordered touring officials to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Labi Cave and other chieftain's offices presented tribute; the Ministry of Rites found seals and papers forged — rewards were stripped and touring officials ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 三十三年詔湖廣川貴總督並節制容美十四司。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year an edict placed the Huguang-Sichuan-Guizhou grand coordinator in overall command of Rongmei's fourteen offices as well.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year an edict placed the Huguang-Sichuan-Guizhou grand coordinator in overall command of Rongmei's fourteen offices.

sentences.zh: 初，容美土官田世爵與土官向元楫累世相仇。

translations.literal: Earlier, Rongmei native official Tian Shijue and native official Xiang Yuanji had been enemies for generations.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Rongmei native official Tian Shijue and native official Xiang Yuanji had been enemies for generations.

sentences.zh: 元楫幼，世爵佯為講好，以女嫁之，謀奪其產，因誣元楫以奸。

translations.literal: Yuanji was young; Shijue feigned reconciliation and married his daughter to him, plotting to seize his property, then slandered Yuanji with adultery.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanji was young; Shijue feigned peace, married him his daughter, plotted to seize his property, then slandered him with adultery.

sentences.zh: 有司恐激變，令自捕元楫，下獄論死。

translations.literal: Local officials, fearing provocation of revolt, ordered him to capture Yuanji himself; Yuanji was imprisoned and sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials, fearing revolt, ordered Yuanji to capture himself; he was imprisoned and sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 世爵遂發兵，盡俘向氏，並籍其土，皆沒入之。

translations.literal: Shijue then sent troops, captured the entire Xiang clan, and registered all their lands — all were absorbed into his holdings.
translations.idiomatic: Shijue then sent troops, captured the entire Xiang clan, and registered all their lands into his own holdings.

sentences.zh: 久之，撫按知其謀，責與元楫對狀，世爵不出，陰與羅峒土舍黃中等謀叛。

translations.literal: After a long time the pacification and inspection officials learned of the plot and ordered Shijue to confront Yuanji in court — Shijue would not appear and secretly plotted rebellion with Luotong native cadet Huang Zhong and others.
translations.idiomatic: Eventually pacification officials learned of the plot and ordered Shijue to confront Yuanji — he refused and secretly plotted rebellion with Huang Zhong of Luotong.

sentences.zh: 於是湖廣巡按御史周如鬥請移荊南道分巡施州衛，以便控制，調廣西清浪等戍軍，以實行伍。

translations.literal: Thereupon Huguang touring censor Zhou Rudou requested that the Jingnan circuit assistant be moved to patrol Shizhou Guard for easier control, and troops from Guangxi Qinglang and other garrisons be transferred to fill the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang touring censor Zhou Rudou then asked that the Jingnan circuit assistant patrol Shizhou Guard for control and that troops from Guangxi's Qinglang garrison and others reinforce the ranks.

sentences.zh: 疏下督臣馮嶽等議，嶽等言：「施州地勢孤懸，不可久居，戍軍亦非一時可集。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down to supervising minister Feng Yue and others for deliberation; Yue and others said: "Shizhou's terrain is isolated and cannot be long occupied; garrison troops cannot be gathered at once.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial went to supervising minister Feng Yue and others, who said: "Shizhou is isolated and cannot be long garrisoned; troops cannot be gathered at once.

sentences.zh: 當移荊瞿守備於施州，九永守備於九谿，上荊南道備巡歷。

translations.literal: The Jingqu garrison command should be moved to Shizhou, the Jiuyong garrison to Jiuxi, and the upper Jingnan circuit assistant should patrol regularly.
translations.idiomatic: Move the Jingqu garrison command to Shizhou, the Jiuyong garrison to Jiuxi, and have the upper Jingnan circuit assistant patrol regularly.

sentences.zh: 至世爵驕橫，有司不能攝治，獨久系元楫何為。

translations.literal: As for Shijue's arrogance, which local officials cannot restrain — what is the use of keeping Yuanji imprisoned so long?
translations.idiomatic: As for Shijue's arrogance, which local officials cannot restrain — why keep Yuanji imprisoned so long?

sentences.zh: 宜假督臣以節制容美之權，問世爵抗違之罪，如不悛，即繩以法。

translations.literal: Grand coordinator authority over Rongmei should be granted to ask Shijue's crime of defiance; if he does not reform, let the law bind him.
translations.idiomatic: Grant the grand coordinator authority over Rongmei to charge Shijue with defiance; if he does not reform, apply the law."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 時龍潭安撫黃俊素貪暴，據支羅洞寨，以睚爔殺人，系獄。

translations.literal: At the time Longtan comforting commissioner Huang Jun was by nature greedy and violent, holding Zhiluo Cave stockade and killing over trifles — he was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Huang Jun of Longtan was greedy and violent, holding Zhiluo Cave stockade and killing over trifles — he was imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 會白草番反，俊子中請立功為父貰罪，已又自求為副指揮，賄當事者許之。

translations.literal: When the Baicao tribes rebelled, Jun's son Zhong asked to earn merit to redeem his father's guilt; afterward he also sought appointment as vice battalion commander, bribing those in charge who agreed.
translations.idiomatic: When the Baicao tribes rebelled, Jun's son Zhong asked to earn merit to redeem his father; he also sought vice battalion command through bribes to those in charge.

sentences.zh: 俊出益驕，乃與中及群盜李仲實等，恣行於四川之雲陽、奉節間，副使熊逵等計擒俊與仲實。

translations.literal: Jun, released, grew all the more arrogant and with Zhong and the bandit Li Zhongshi and others ran riot between Yunyang and Fengjie in Sichuan — Vice Commissioner Xiong Kui and others planned to capture Jun and Zhongshi.
translations.idiomatic: Released, Jun grew bolder still and with Zhong and bandit Li Zhongshi raided between Yunyang and Fengjie in Sichuan — vice commissioner Xiong Kui and others planned their capture.

sentences.zh: 俊死於獄，中自縛出降，執余黨譚景雷等自贖。

translations.literal: Jun died in prison; Zhong bound himself and surrendered, handing over the rest such as Tan Jinglei to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: Jun died in prison; Zhong bound himself and surrendered, handing over accomplices such as Tan Jinglei to redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 帝命追戮俊，梟示，仲實等論斬，中謫戍，而賞有功者。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Jun posthumously executed and exposed, Zhongshi and others sentenced to decapitation, Zhong exiled to garrison duty, and those with merit rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Jun posthumously executed and exposed, Zhongshi and others decapitated, Zhong exiled to garrison duty, and the meritorious rewarded.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，命容美宣撫田九霄襲職，賜紅纻衣一襲，以浙江黃宗山擊倭之功也。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year Tian Jiuxiao of Rongmei pacification superintendent was ordered to succeed to office and was given one suit of red silk — for merit against Japanese pirates under Huang Zongshan of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year Tian Jiuxiao was ordered to succeed at Rongmei and given a suit of red silk for merit against Japanese pirates under Zhejiang's Huang Zongshan.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年，吏科給事朱繪等言，湖廣施州衛忠路安撫覃大寧一日奏五上，語多不實，請究治。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longqing the supervising secretary Zhu Hui and others of the Ministry of Personnel said that Huguang Shizhou Guard Zhonglu comforting commissioner Qin Daning submitted five memorials in one day, mostly untrue — investigation was requested.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing 1 supervising secretary Zhu Hui of the Ministry of Personnel said Qin Daning of Shizhou Guard's Zhonglu comforting commission filed five memorials in one day, mostly false — investigation was requested.

sentences.zh: 都察院議，金峒安撫上舍覃璧爭印相殺，及磁峒不當轄四川。

translations.literal: The Censorate deliberated: Jintong comforting commission native cadet Qin Bi fought over seals and killed one another, and Cidong should not be under Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate added that Qin Bi of Jintong fought over seals and killed one another, and that Cidong should not fall under Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 俱下撫按官勘報。

translations.literal: All were referred to pacification and inspection officials for investigation and report.
translations.idiomatic: All were referred to pacification officials for investigation.

sentences.zh: 四年，覃璧作亂，傷官軍，撫按請治失事諸臣罪。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Qin Bi rebelled and wounded government troops; pacification officials asked punishment for officials who failed in duty.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Qin Bi rebelled and wounded government troops; pacification officials sought punishment for negligent officers.

sentences.zh: 兵部言：「本衛孤懸境外，事起倉猝，宜從寬貰，以責後功。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said: "This guard stands alone beyond the border; the affair arose in haste — leniency should be shown to demand later merit.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War said: "This guard stands alone beyond the border and the affair arose in haste — leniency should be shown to demand later merit."

sentences.zh: 」帝然之，命所司相機剿撫。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved and ordered the responsible offices to suppress or pacify as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed and ordered responsible offices to suppress or pacify as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 五年，巡撫劉愨以覃璧平，條議五事：「一，請以川東所轄巫山、建始、黔江、萬縣改屬上荊道。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Grand Coordinator Liu Kui, with Qin Bi pacified, submitted five proposals: "First, request that Wushan, Jianshi, Qianjiang, and Wanxian under eastern Sichuan be transferred to upper Jing circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, with Qin Bi pacified, Grand Coordinator Liu Kui submitted five proposals: "First, transfer Wushan, Jianshi, Qianjiang, and Wanxian of eastern Sichuan to upper Jing circuit.

sentences.zh: 一，以荊州去施州衛遠，不便巡歷。

translations.literal: Second, because Jingzhou is far from Shizhou Guard and inconvenient to patrol regularly.
translations.idiomatic: Second, because Jingzhou is far from Shizhou Guard and hard to patrol.

sentences.zh: 夷陵西有傅友德所辟取蜀故道，名百里荒者，抵衛僅五百余裏。

translations.literal: West of Yiling is the old road to Shu opened by Fu Youde, called the Hundred-Li Wilderness, only five hundred-odd li from the guard.
translations.idiomatic: West of Yiling lies the old road to Shu opened by Fu Youde, called the Hundred-Li Wilderness, only five hundred-odd li from the guard.

sentences.zh: 請以巴東之石砫司巡檢、施州衛之州門驛、三會驛並移近地，俾閭井聯絡。

translations.literal: Request that the Shizhu circuit inspector of Badong, the Zhoumen post of Shizhou Guard, and the Sanhui post all be moved nearer so that hamlets and wells connect.
translations.idiomatic: Move Badong's Shizhu inspector, Shizhou Guard's Zhoumen post, and the Sanhui post nearer so settlements connect.

sentences.zh: 而於百里荒及東卜壟仍創建哨堡，令千戶一員，督班軍百人戍守。

translations.literal: Yet at the Hundred-Li Wilderness and Dongbulong still create sentry forts, with one battalion commander and a hundred garrison soldiers to guard.
translations.idiomatic: Still create sentry forts at the Hundred-Li Wilderness and Dongbulong, each with a battalion commander and a hundred garrison soldiers.

sentences.zh: 一，施州衛延袤頗廣，物產最饒，衛官朘削，致民逃夷地為亂。

translations.literal: Third, Shizhou Guard's territory is broad and its products abundant, yet guard officers embezzle, driving the people to flee into tribal lands and rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Third, Shizhou Guard's territory is broad and rich, yet officers embezzle, driving people to flee into tribal lands and rebel.

sentences.zh: 宜裁通判設同知，撫治民蠻，均平徭賦，勿額外橫索。

translations.literal: It is fitting to abolish the transit judge and establish an assistant prefect to pacify civilians and tribes, equalize corvée levies, and forbid extra exactions.
translations.idiomatic: Abolish the transit judge, establish an assistant prefect to pacify civilians and tribes, equalize corvée, and forbid extra exactions.

sentences.zh: 一，金峒世官不宜遽絕，貸覃勝罪，降安撫為峒長，聽支羅所百戶提調。

translations.literal: Fourth, Jintong's hereditary office should not be abruptly ended — pardon Qin Sheng's crime, reduce comforting commissioner to cave chieftain, and let Zhiluo battalion's company commander direct him.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, Jintong's hereditary line should not end abruptly — pardon Qin Sheng, reduce comforting commissioner to cave chieftain, and let Zhiluo's company commander direct him.

sentences.zh: 一，施州所轄十四司應襲官舍，必先白道院，始許理事。

translations.literal: Fifth, among the fourteen offices under Shizhou, hereditary native cadets must report to the circuit intendant before conducting affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, among Shizhou's fourteen offices, hereditary native cadets must report to the circuit intendant before acting.

sentences.zh: 其擅立名號者，請嚴治，並令兵巡道每歲經歷施州，豫行調集各官舍獎諭，令赴學觀化。

translations.literal: Those who presumptuously establish titles should be strictly punished, and the military patrol circuit should visit Shizhou yearly in advance, gathering native cadets for encouragement and sending them to schools for transformation.
translations.idiomatic: Those who presumptuously establish titles should be strictly punished; the military patrol circuit should visit Shizhou yearly, gather native cadets for encouragement, and send them to schools."

sentences.zh: 」俱從之。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 萬歷十一年，湖廣撫按奏：「施州衛施南等宣撫司各官，仍聽鎮筸參將節制，載入敕書，以一事權。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Wanli the Huguang pacification and inspection officials memorialized: "The various officials of Shinan and other pacification superintendents under Shizhou Guard should still be placed under the Zhengan regional vice commander, recorded in the patent of appointment, to unify authority.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 11 Huguang pacification officials reported: "Officials of Shinan and other pacification superintendents under Shizhou Guard should remain under the Zhengan regional vice commander, recorded in the appointment patent, to unify authority.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十二年，容美宣撫田元疏言：「六月間，谷賊復叛，撫治兩臣調用土兵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Chongzhen, Rongmei Pacification Superintendent Tian Yuan memorialized: "[In the sixth month the Gu bandits rebelled again, and the two pacifying commissioners mobilized native troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongzhen 12, Rongmei Pacification Superintendent Tian Yuan reported: "[In the sixth month the Gu rebels rose again, and the two pacifying commissioners called up native troops.

sentences.zh: 臣即捐行糧戰馬，立遣土兵七千，令副長官陳一聖等將之前行。

translations.literal: This official immediately contributed traveling grain and war horses, immediately dispatched seven thousand native troops, and ordered Vice Chieftain Chen Yisheng and others to lead them forward.
translations.idiomatic: I at once donated marching provisions and war horses, immediately sent seven thousand native troops, and had Vice Chieftain Chen Yisheng and others lead them ahead.

sentences.zh: 悍軍鄧維昌等憚於征調，遂與譚正賓結七十二村，鳩銀萬七千兩，賂巴東知縣蔡文升以逼民從軍之文上報，阻忠義而啟邊釁。

translations.literal: Fierce soldiers Deng Weichang and others feared conscription; they then with Tan Zhengbin united seventy-two villages, pooled seventeen thousand taels of silver, bribed Badong Magistrate Cai Wensheng to report upward a document forcing the people to join the army, obstructing loyalty and righteousness and provoking border trouble.
translations.idiomatic: The fierce soldiers Deng Weichang and others shrank from the levy; they joined Tan Zhengbin and seventy-two villages, raised seventeen thousand taels of silver, and bribed Badong Magistrate Cai Wensheng into memorializing a draft to force the people into service, blocking the loyal and opening a border quarrel.

sentences.zh: 」帝命撫按核其事。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the pacification and inspection officials to investigate the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the provincial pacification and inspection officials to verify the affair.

sentences.zh: 時中原寇盜充斥，時事日非，即土司征調不至，亦不能問矣。

translations.literal: At that time bandits and robbers filled the Central Plains and affairs grew worse day by day; even if the tribal headmen failed to answer mobilization, nothing could be done about it.
translations.idiomatic: By then the heartland swarmed with rebels and the times worsened daily; even when native offices ignored a summons, the court could no longer hold them to account.

sentences.zh: 永順軍民宣慰使司

translations.literal: Yongshun Military-Civilian Pacification Commissioner
