translations.idiomatic: Yongshun Military-Civilian Pacification Commissioner

sentences.zh: 永順，漢武陵、隋辰州、唐溪州地也。

translations.literal: Yongshun was the territory of Han Wuling, Sui Chenzhou, and Tang Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yongshun occupied the lands of Han's Wuling, Sui's Chenzhou, and Tang's Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 宋初為永順州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Song it became Yongshun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In early Song it was made Yongshun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐中，溪州刺史彭仕羲叛，臨以大兵，仕羲降。

translations.literal: In the Jiayou era Xizhou Prefect Peng Shixi rebelled; faced with a great army, Shixi surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: During Jiayou, Xizhou Prefect Peng Shixi revolted; pressed by a large force, Shixi submitted.

sentences.zh: 熙寧中，築下溪州城，賜名會溪。

translations.literal: In the Xining era Lower Xizhou city was built and granted the name Huixi.
translations.idiomatic: Under Xining the Lower Xizhou fort was built and named Huixi.

sentences.zh: 元時，彭萬潛自改為永順等處軍民安撫司。

translations.literal: In Yuan times Peng Wanqian on his own changed it to the Yongshun and other places Military-Civilian Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan, Peng Wanqian renamed it the Yongshun and other places Military-Civilian Pacification Office.

sentences.zh: 洪武五年，永順宣慰使順德汪倫、堂厓安撫使月直遣人上其所受偽夏印，詔賜文綺襲衣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Hongwu, Yongshun Pacification Commissioner Shunde Wang Lun and Tangya Pacification Superintendent Yuezhi sent men to present the seals they had received from the fake Xia regime; an edict granted them patterned silks and robes of succession.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 5, Yongshun Pacification Commissioner Shunde Wang Lun and Tangya Pacification Superintendent Yuezhi sent envoys to surrender the seals they had received from the Xia regime; the court granted patterned silks and investiture robes.

sentences.zh: 遂置永順等處軍民宣慰使司，隸湖廣都指揮使司。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Yongshun and other places Military-Civilian Pacification Commissioner was established, subordinate to the Huguang Regional Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongshun and other places Military-Civilian Pacification Commissioner was then established, placed under the Huguang Regional Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 領州三，曰南渭，曰施溶，曰上谿；

translations.literal: It governed three prefectures, namely Nanwei, Shirong, and Shangxi;
translations.idiomatic: It administered three prefectures: Nanwei, Shirong, and Shangxi;

sentences.zh: 長官司六，曰臘惹洞，曰麥著黃洞，曰驢遲洞，曰施溶溪，曰白崖洞，曰田家洞。

translations.literal: and six chieftain's offices, namely Layedong, Maizhuanghuangdong, Lvchidong, Shirongxi, Baiyadong, and Tianjiadong.
translations.idiomatic: and six chieftain's offices: Layedong, Maizhuanghuangdong, Lvchidong, Shirongxi, Baiyadong, and Tianjiadong.

sentences.zh: 九年，永順宣慰彭添保遣其弟義保等貢馬及方物，賜衣幣有差。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Yongshun Pacification Commissioner Peng Tianbao sent his younger brother Yibao and others to present tribute horses and local products; robes and gifts were granted in differing measure.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Yongshun Pacification Commissioner Peng Tianbao sent his brother Yibao and others to offer horses and local products; robes and gifts were granted in due measure.

sentences.zh: 自是，每三年一入貢。

translations.literal: From this time tribute was presented once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter tribute came once every three years.

sentences.zh: 永樂十六年，宣慰彭源之子仲率土官部長六百六十七人貢馬。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Yongle, Pacification Commissioner Peng Yuan's son Zhong led six hundred sixty-seven native-official chiefs to present tribute horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 16, Pacification Commissioner Peng Yuan's son Zhong led six hundred sixty-seven native chiefs to present tribute horses.

sentences.zh: 成化三年，兵部尚書程信請調永順兵征都掌蠻。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chenghua, Minister of War Cheng Xin requested mobilization of Yongshun troops to campaign against the Duzhang Miao.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 3, Minister of War Cheng Xin asked that Yongshun troops be mobilized against the Duzhang Miao.

sentences.zh: 十三年以征苗功，命宣慰彭顯英進散官一階，仍賜敕獎勞。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, for merit in campaigning against the Miao, Pacification Commissioner Peng Xianying was ordered to advance one grade in honorary rank and was still granted an edict commending and comforting him.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, for merit against the Miao, Pacification Commissioner Peng Xianying was promoted one honorary grade and again received an edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 十五年免永順賦。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Yongshun's tax levy was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Yongshun's taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 弘治七年，貴州奏平苗功，以宣慰彭世麒等與有勞，世麒乞升職。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Hongzhi, Guizhou reported merit in pacifying the Miao; Pacification Commissioner Peng Shiqi and others had shared in the labor, and Shiqi requested promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi 7, Guizhou reported success in pacifying the Miao; Pacification Commissioner Peng Shiqi and others had taken part, and Shiqi asked for promotion.

sentences.zh: 兵部言非例，請進世麒階昭勇將軍，仍賜敕褒獎，從之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said it was not precedent and requested promoting Shiqi to the rank of Brave-and-Courageous General while still granting an edict of praise and reward; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War said this was not precedent but asked that Shiqi be advanced to Brave-and-Courageous General and still receive a commendatory edict; approved.

sentences.zh: 八年，世麒進馬謝恩。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Shiqi presented horses in thanks for imperial grace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Shiqi presented horses in gratitude.

sentences.zh: 十四年，世麒以北邊有警，請帥土兵一萬赴延綏助討賊。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Shiqi, because the northern border had an alarm, requested to lead ten thousand native troops to Yan-sui to help attack bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, with trouble on the northern frontier, Shiqi asked to lead ten thousand native troops to Yan-sui to help suppress the rebels.

sentences.zh: 兵部議不可，賜敕獎諭，並賜奏事人路費鈔千貫，免其明年朝覲，以方聽調征賊婦米魯故也。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War deliberated that this could not be done, granted an edict of commendation, and also granted the memorial presenter traveling-expense notes of one thousand strings; he was exempted from the next year's court audience, because he was presently being mobilized to campaign against the bandit woman Milu.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War ruled against it but granted an edict of praise, gave the memorial presenter one thousand strings of traveling notes, and excused him from the next year's audience, since he was already on campaign against the bandit woman Milu.

sentences.zh: 正德元年以世麒從征有功，賜紅織金麒麟服，世麒進馬謝恩。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengde, because Shiqi had merit in following the campaign, he was granted red brocade robes with gold kylin; Shiqi presented horses in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 1, for merit on campaign, Shiqi was granted red brocade with gold kylin patterns; he presented horses in thanks.

sentences.zh: 二年進馬賀立中宮，命給賞如例。

translations.literal: In the second year he presented horses to congratulate the establishment of the Middle Palace; he was ordered rewards according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he presented horses to congratulate the establishment of the empress; rewards were ordered as usual.

sentences.zh: 五年，永順與保靖爭地相攻，累年不決，訴於朝，命各罰米三百石。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Yongshun and Baojing fought over territory; for many years it was unresolved; they appealed to the court, which ordered each fined three hundred shi of rice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Yongshun and Baojing warred over land; the dispute dragged on for years until they appealed to court, which fined each side three hundred shi of rice.

sentences.zh: 六年，四川賊藍廷瑞、鄢本恕等及其黨二十八人倡亂兩川，鳥合十余萬人，僭王號，置四十八營，攻城殺吏，流毒黔、楚。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Sichuan bandits Lan Tingrui, Yan Benshu, and twenty-eight of their followers incited rebellion in the two Shu, mustering more than one hundred thousand men, usurped kingly titles, set up forty-eight camps, attacked cities and killed officials, and spread harm through Qian and Chu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the Sichuan rebels Lan Tingrui, Yan Benshu, and twenty-eight associates raised rebellion in both Shu, gathering more than one hundred thousand men, assuming royal titles, establishing forty-eight camps, storming cities and killing officials, and ravaging Qian and Chu.

sentences.zh: 總制尚書洪鐘等討之，不克。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Minister Hong Zhong and others campaigned against them but could not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Hong Zhong and others attacked them without success.

sentences.zh: 已而為官軍所遏，乏食，乃佯聽撫，劫掠自如。

translations.literal: Later they were blocked by government troops and lacked food; they then feigned acceptance of pacification while raiding as before.
translations.idiomatic: Later, hemmed in by government troops and short of provisions, they pretended to accept pacification while plundering as before.

sentences.zh: 廷瑞以女結婚於永順土舍彭世麟，冀緩兵。

translations.literal: Tingrui married his daughter to Yongshun native-office holder Peng Shilin, hoping to slow the troops.
translations.idiomatic: Tingrui betrothed his daughter to Yongshun native cadet Peng Shilin, hoping to stall the army.

sentences.zh: 世麟偽許之，因與約期。

translations.literal: Shilin falsely agreed and therefore set a date with them.
translations.idiomatic: Shilin pretended consent and fixed a meeting date.

sentences.zh: 廷瑞、本恕及王金珠等二十八人皆來會，世麟伏兵擒之，余賊潰渡河，官兵追圍之，擒斬及溺死者七百余人。

translations.literal: Tingrui, Benshu, Wang Jinzhu, and the twenty-eight others all came to the meeting; Shilin ambushed and captured them; the remaining bandits fled across the river; government troops pursued and surrounded them; more than seven hundred were captured and killed or drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Tingrui, Benshu, Wang Jinzhu, and all twenty-eight came to the rendezvous; Shilin's hidden troops seized them; the rest broke across the river; pursuing troops encircled them and killed or drowned more than seven hundred.

sentences.zh: 總制、巡撫以捷聞，獎賚有差，論者以是役世麟為首功雲。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator and pacification commissioner reported victory; rewards differed in grade; commentators regarded Shilin as having the chief merit in this campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinator and pacification commissioner reported the victory; rewards varied by rank; commentators held Shilin chiefly responsible for the success.

sentences.zh: 七年，賊劉三等自遂平趨東臯，宣慰彭明輔及都指揮曹鵬等以土軍追擊之，賊倉卒渡河，溺死者二千人，斬首八十余級。

translations.literal: In the seventh year bandits Liu San and others from Suiping rushed toward Donggao; Pacification Commissioner Peng Mingfu and Regional Vice Commander Cao Peng and others with native troops pursued them; the bandits in haste crossed the river; two thousand drowned; more than eighty heads were cut off.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the rebels Liu San and others fled from Suiping toward Donggao; Pacification Commissioner Peng Mingfu and Regional Vice Commander Cao Peng pursued with native troops; the enemy rushed the river in panic; two thousand drowned and more than eighty heads were taken.

sentences.zh: 巡撫李士實以聞。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Li Shishi reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Li Shishi memorialized the victory.

sentences.zh: 命永順宣慰格外加賞，仍給明輔誥命。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered extra reward for the Yongshun Pacification Commissioner and still granted Mingfu a patent of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered additional rewards for the Yongshun Pacification Commissioner and granted Mingfu a patent of appointment.

sentences.zh: 十年，致仕宣慰彭世麒獻大木三十，次者二百，親督運至京，子明輔所進如之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year retired Pacification Commissioner Peng Shiqi presented thirty great timbers and two hundred lesser ones, personally supervising transport to the capital; his son Mingfu's presentation was the same.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the retired Pacification Commissioner Peng Shiqi presented thirty great timbers and two hundred lesser ones, personally escorting them to the capital; his son Mingfu made a like offering.

sentences.zh: 賜敕褒諭，賞進奏人鈔千貫。

translations.literal: An edict commended him; the memorial presenter was rewarded one thousand strings of notes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised him and granted the memorial presenter one thousand strings of paper money.

sentences.zh: 十三年，世麒獻大楠本四百七十，子明輔亦進大木備營建。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Shiqi presented four hundred seventy great nan timbers; his son Mingfu also presented great timbers for construction.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Shiqi offered four hundred seventy great nan logs; Mingfu also sent great timbers for building works.

sentences.zh: 詔世麒升都指揮使，賞蟒衣三襲，仍致仕；

translations.literal: An edict promoted Shiqi to Regional Vice Commander, granted three python robes, and he still retired;
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Regional Vice Commander, given three python robes, and allowed to remain in retirement;

sentences.zh: 明輔授正三品散官，賞飛魚服三襲，賜敕獎勵，仍令鎮巡官宴勞之。

translations.literal: Mingfu was given honorary third rank, granted three flying-fish robes, granted an edict of reward, and still ordered the pacification and inspection officials to feast and comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: Mingfu received honorary third rank, three flying-fish robes, and a reward edict; the pacification and inspection officials were also ordered to feast and honor him.

sentences.zh: 時政出權幸，恩澤皆由於幹請。

translations.literal: At that time government came from powerful favorites; favors all came through solicitation.
translations.idiomatic: Government then flowed from powerful favorites, and every grace came by private petition.

sentences.zh: 於是郴州民頌世麒征賊時號令嚴明，其土官彭芳等亦頌世麒功，乞蟒衣玉帶。

translations.literal: Then Chenzhou common people praised Shiqi's strict commands when campaigning against bandits; his native officials Peng Fang and others also praised Shiqi's merit, requesting python robes and jade belts.
translations.idiomatic: Chenzhou people praised Shiqi's stern discipline on campaign; his native officials Peng Fang and others likewise praised his service and begged python robes and jade belts for him.

sentences.zh: 兵部格不可，乃已。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War rejected this as impossible, and the matter ended.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War refused as irregular, and the request lapsed.

sentences.zh: 世麒辭賞，請立坊，賜名曰表勞。

translations.literal: Shiqi declined the reward and requested a memorial arch; the granted name was Biaolao.
translations.idiomatic: Shiqi declined the gifts and asked instead for a commemorative arch; the court named it Biaolao, "Commending Merit."

sentences.zh: 會有保靖兩宣慰爭兩江口之議，詞連明輔，主者議逮治。

translations.literal: When the two Baojing and Yongshun pacification commissioners disputed the Two-River Mouth, the words implicated Mingfu; those in charge deliberated arrest and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: A dispute over the Two-River Mouth between the Baojing and Yongshun pacification commissioners implicated Mingfu; the authorities proposed arresting him.

sentences.zh: 明輔乃令蠻民奏其從征功，悉辭香爐山應得升賞，以贖逮治之辱。

translations.literal: Mingfu then had tribal people memorialize his campaign merit, entirely declining the promotion and rewards due from Incense-Burner Mountain, to redeem the shame of impending arrest.
translations.idiomatic: Mingfu had tribal subjects memorialize his campaign service and renounce all promotion and rewards tied to Incense-Burner Mountain, seeking to expiate the disgrace of impending punishment.

sentences.zh: 部議悉已之。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and ended it all.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry reviewed the matter and let everything drop.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖六年，論擒岑猛功，免應襲宣慰彭宗漢赴京，而加宗漢父明輔、祖世麒銀幣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiajing, discussing merit in capturing Cen Meng, the heir-apparent Pacification Commissioner Peng Zonghan was excused from going to the capital, while Zonghan's father Mingfu and grandfather Shiqi were given additional silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 6, for merit in capturing Cen Meng, heir-apparent Pacification Commissioner Peng Zonghan was excused from attending court, while his father Mingfu and grandfather Shiqi received extra silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，巡撫陸傑言：「酉陽與永順以采木仇殺，保靖又煽惑其間，大為地方患。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Pacification Commissioner Lu Jie said: "[Youyang and Yongshun killed each other over timber cutting; Baojing again stirred them up between -- a great calamity for the region.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Pacification Commissioner Lu Jie reported: "[Youyang and Yongshun have been killing one another over timber rights, and Baojing has been fanning the quarrel -- a grave affliction for the region.

sentences.zh: 」乃命川、湖撫臣撫戢，勿釀兵端。

translations.literal: Thereupon the emperor ordered Sichuan and Huguang pacification officials to pacify and restrain them, not to brew military incidents.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then ordered the Sichuan and Huguang pacification officials to calm them and forbid any new outbreak of fighting.

sentences.zh: 是年，免永順秋糧。

translations.literal: That year Yongshun's autumn grain was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yongshun's autumn grain tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 三十三年冬，調永順土兵協剿倭賊於蘇、松。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, winter, Yongshun native troops were mobilized to jointly suppress Japanese pirates in Su and Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year, winter, Yongshun native troops were called up to help suppress Japanese pirates in Suzhou and Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 明年，永順宣慰彭翼南統兵三千，致仕宣慰彭明輔統兵二千，俱會於松江。

translations.literal: The next year Yongshun Pacification Commissioner Peng Yinan commanded three thousand troops; retired Pacification Commissioner Peng Mingfu commanded two thousand; both assembled at Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Yongshun Pacification Commissioner Peng Yinan led three thousand men and retired Pacification Commissioner Peng Mingfu two thousand; both joined at Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 時保靖兵敗賊於石塘灣。

translations.literal: At that time Baojing troops defeated the bandits at Shitang Bay.
translations.idiomatic: By then Baojing troops had already beaten the pirates at Shitang Bay.

sentences.zh: 永順兵邀擊，賊奔王江涇，大潰。

translations.literal: Yongshun troops intercepted and struck; the bandits fled to Wangjiangjing and were utterly routed.
translations.idiomatic: Yongshun troops cut them off; the enemy fled to Wangjiangjing and collapsed in complete rout.

sentences.zh: 保靖兵最，永順次之，帝降敕獎勵，各賜銀幣，翼南賜三品服。

translations.literal: Baojing troops ranked first, Yongshun second; the emperor sent down an edict of reward; each was granted silver and silks; Yinan was granted third-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: Baojing ranked first and Yongshun second; the emperor issued a reward edict, granting silver and silks to each, and third-rank robes to Yinan.

sentences.zh: 先是，永順兵剿新場倭，倭故不出，保靖兵為所誘遽先入，永順土官田菑、田豐等亦爭入，為賊所圍，皆死之。

translations.literal: Earlier Yongshun troops had suppressed Japanese at Xinchang; the Japanese deliberately did not come out; Baojing troops were lured and rashly entered first; Yongshun native officials Tian Zai, Tian Feng, and others also vied to enter and were surrounded by the bandits -- all died.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, at Xinchang, Yongshun troops had hunted the Japanese, who held back; Baojing men were baited into charging in first; Yongshun native officers Tian Zai, Tian Feng, and others rushed in as well, were surrounded, and all perished.

sentences.zh: 議者皆言督撫經略失宜，致永順兵再戰再北。

translations.literal: Critics all said the grand coordinator's planning had been improper, causing Yongshun troops to fight twice and retreat twice.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators blamed the grand coordinator's strategy for Yongshun's two defeats in succession.

sentences.zh: 及王江涇之戰，保靖掎之，永順角之，斬獲一千九百余級，倭為奪氣，蓋東南戰功第一雲。

translations.literal: At the Wangjiangjing battle Baojing held them fast while Yongshun cornered them; more than nineteen hundred were cut down or captured; the Japanese lost their spirit -- regarded as the foremost southeast campaign merit.
translations.idiomatic: At Wangjiangjing, Baojing pinned the enemy while Yongshun closed the kill; more than nineteen hundred were slain or taken, and the Japanese lost heart -- held to be the greatest victory in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 時邀功者方行賞，翼南遂授昭毅將軍。

translations.literal: At that time those claiming merit were being rewarded; Yinan was then appointed Brave-and-Steadfast General.
translations.idiomatic: While merit claims were being rewarded, Yinan was appointed Brave-and-Steadfast General.

sentences.zh: 已，升右參政管宣慰事，與明輔俱受銀幣之賜。

translations.literal: Later he was promoted to Right Administration Commissioner managing pacification affairs; he and Mingfu both received grants of silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: He was later made Right Administration Commissioner in charge of pacification affairs; both he and Mingfu received silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 時保、永二宣慰破倭後，兵驕，所過皆劫掠，緣江上下苦之。

translations.literal: At that time the two Baojing and Yongshun pacification commissioners, after defeating the Japanese, grew arrogant in arms; wherever they passed they plundered; up and down the riverbanks all suffered.
translations.idiomatic: After the victory, the Baojing and Yongshun pacification commissioners' troops grew insolent and plundered wherever they marched, bringing misery along the rivers.

sentences.zh: 御史請究治，部議以土兵新有功，遽加罰，失遠人心，宜諭責之。

translations.literal: Censors requested investigation and punishment; the ministry deliberated that the native troops had fresh merit -- sudden punishment would lose distant hearts -- they should be admonished.
translations.idiomatic: Censors called for punishment; the ministry argued that the native troops had just won merit and sudden penalties would alienate distant peoples -- they should be rebuked instead.

sentences.zh: 並令浙、直練鄉勇，嗣後不得輕調土兵。

translations.literal: And Zhejiang and the direct circuit were ordered to train militia; thereafter native troops must not be lightly mobilized.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang and the metropolitan circuit were also ordered to train local militia; native troops were not to be lightly called up again.

sentences.zh: 四十二年以獻大木功再論賞，加明輔都指揮使，賜蟒衣，其子掌宣慰司事，右參政彭翼南為右布政使，賜飛魚服，仍賜敕獎勵。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year, again discussing reward for presenting great timbers, Mingfu was made Regional Vice Commander and granted python robes; his son managed pacification affairs; Right Administration Commissioner Peng Yinan was made Right Pacification Commissioner and granted flying-fish robes, still granted an edict of reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year, for presenting great timbers, Mingfu was made Regional Vice Commander and given python robes; his son took charge of the pacification office; Right Administration Commissioner Peng Yinan became Right Pacification Commissioner with flying-fish robes and a reward edict.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，永順復獻大木，詔加明輔、翼南二品服。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year Yongshun again presented great timbers; an edict added second-rank robes for Mingfu and Yinan.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year Yongshun again sent great timbers; an edict granted Mingfu and Yinan second-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 萬歷二十五年，東事棘，調永順兵萬人赴援。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Wanli, eastern affairs were critical; ten thousand Yongshun troops were mobilized for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 25, with the eastern frontier in crisis, ten thousand Yongshun troops were mobilized for relief.

sentences.zh: 宣慰彭元錦請自備衣糧聽調，既而支吾，有要挾之跡，命罷之。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Peng Yuanjin requested to provide his own clothing and grain and heed the summons; later he prevaricated, showing signs of coercion; he was ordered dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Peng Yuanjin offered to supply his own provisions and obey the call; later he stalled and showed signs of extortion; he was ordered to stand down.

sentences.zh: 三十八年賜元錦都指揮銜，給蟒衣一襲，妻汪氏封夫人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year Yuanjin was granted the title of Regional Vice Commander, given one python robe; his wife Lady Wang was enfeoffed as a lady.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year Yuanjin received the rank of Regional Vice Commander and one python robe; his wife, Lady Wang, was enfeoffed as a lady.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，永順貢馬後期，減賞。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year Yongshun's tribute horses were late; rewards were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year Yongshun's tribute horses arrived late and its reward was cut.

sentences.zh: 兵部言：「前調宣慰元錦兵三千人援遼，已半載，至關者僅七百余人。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said: "[Previously three thousand troops of Pacification Commissioner Yuanjin were mobilized to aid Liaodong; already half a year -- those reaching the pass were only a little over seven hundred.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War reported: "[Three thousand men under Pacification Commissioner Yuanjin were sent to aid Liaodong; after half a year, barely seven hundred had reached the frontier pass.

sentences.zh: 」命究主兵者。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered investigation of those responsible for the troops.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered those responsible for the troops to be investigated.

sentences.zh: 四十八年進元錦都督僉事。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year Yuanjin was advanced to Assistant Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year Yuanjin was promoted to Assistant Regional Commander.

sentences.zh: 先是，元錦以調兵三千為不足立功，願以萬兵往。

translations.literal: Earlier Yuanjin had held that three thousand troops were insufficient for establishing merit and wished to go with ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Yuanjin had said three thousand men were too few to win distinction and volunteered ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 朝廷嘉其忠，加恩優渥。

translations.literal: The court praised his loyalty and bestowed favors generously.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised his loyalty and heaped favors upon him.

sentences.zh: 既而檄調八千，僅以三千，塞責，又上疏稱病，為巡撫所劾，得旨切責。

translations.literal: Later when eight thousand were requisitioned he sent only three thousand to fulfill obligation; he also memorialized claiming illness; the pacification commissioner impeached him; he received an edict of stern reproof.
translations.idiomatic: When eight thousand were later demanded he sent only three thousand to satisfy duty; he then memorialized illness; the pacification commissioner impeached him and he received a stern edict of rebuke.

sentences.zh: 元錦不得已行，兵抵通州北，聞三路敗恤，遂大潰。

translations.literal: Yuanjin had no choice but to go; when the troops reached north of Tongzhou they heard of defeat on three routes and thereupon utterly collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjin set out at last; his force reached north of Tongzhou, heard that three armies had been routed, and broke completely.

sentences.zh: 於是巡撫徐兆魁言：「調永順兵八千，費逾十萬，今奔潰，虛糜無益。

translations.literal: Then Pacification Commissioner Xu Zhaokui said: "[Mobilizing eight thousand Yongshun troops cost more than one hundred thousand; now they fled in rout -- waste without benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Xu Zhaokui then reported: "[Eight thousand Yongshun troops were mobilized at a cost exceeding one hundred thousand; they have now scattered in rout, wasting funds to no purpose.

sentences.zh: 」罷之。

translations.literal: They were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: They were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 保靖州軍民宣慰使司

translations.literal: Baojing Prefecture Military-Civilian Pacification Commissioner
translations.idiomatic: Baojing Prefecture Military-Civilian Pacification Commissioner

sentences.zh: 宣德元年，宣慰彭大蟲可宜遣子順來貢。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuande, Pacification Commissioner Peng Dachong Keyi sent his son Shun to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 1, Pacification Commissioner Peng Dachong Keyi sent his son Shun to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年，兵部奏：「保靖舊有二宣慰，一為人所殺，一以殺人當死，其同知以下官皆缺，請改流官治之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the Ministry of War memorialized: "[Baojing formerly had two pacification commissioners; one was killed by others, one deserved death for killing; their vice commissioners and lower offices were all vacant -- request changing to regular officials to govern.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the Ministry of War reported: "[Baojing once had two pacification commissioners; one was murdered, the other faced execution for murder; vice commissioners and lower posts were all vacant -- it should be placed under regular officials.

sentences.zh: 」帝以蠻性難馴，流官不諳土俗，令都督蕭授擇眾所推服者以聞。

translations.literal: The emperor held that tribal nature is hard to tame and regular officials do not understand native customs; he ordered Regional Commander Xiao Shou to select one whom the masses recommend and defer to, and report.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied that tribal peoples are hard to govern and regular officials do not know local custom; he ordered Regional Commander Xiao Shou to choose someone the people would accept and report.

sentences.zh: 正統十四年，保靖宣慰與族人彭南木答等相訐奏，既而講和，願輸米贖誣奏罪，從之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Zhengtong, the Baojing Pacification Commissioner and kinsman Peng Nanmuda and others mutually accused in memorials; later they made peace and wished to pay rice to redeem the crime of false accusation -- approved.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 14 the Baojing Pacification Commissioner and his kinsman Peng Nanmuda and others exchanged accusations; they later reconciled and offered rice to redeem the penalty for false memorials; approved.

sentences.zh: 景泰七年命調保靖土兵協剿銅鼓、五開、黎平諸蠻，先頒賞犒之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jingtai an order mobilized Baojing native troops to jointly suppress the Tonggu, Wukai, Liping, and other tribal groups; rewards were first distributed to encourage them.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai 7, Baojing native troops were ordered to help suppress the Tonggu, Wukai, Liping, and other tribes; rewards were issued in advance to hearten them.

sentences.zh: 天順二年敕宣慰彭舍怕俾即選兵進討。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianshun an edict ordered Pacification Commissioner Peng Shepa to immediately select troops and advance to attack.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 2 an edict told Pacification Commissioner Peng Shepa to choose troops at once and march to attack.

sentences.zh: 三年，保靖奏夏災。

translations.literal: In the third year Baojing reported summer disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Baojing reported a summer disaster.

sentences.zh: 成化二年，以保靖宣慰彭顯宗征蠻有功，命給誥命。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chenghua, because Baojing Pacification Commissioner Peng Xianzong had merit campaigning against tribal rebels, he was ordered given a patent.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 2, for merit against tribal rebels, Baojing Pacification Commissioner Peng Xianzong was granted a patent of appointment.

sentences.zh: 三年復調保靖兵征都掌蠻。

translations.literal: In the third year Baojing troops were again mobilized to campaign against the Duzhang Miao.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Baojing troops were again called up against the Duzhang Miao.

sentences.zh: 五年免保靖宣慰諸土司成化二年稅糧八百五十三石，以屢調征廣西及荊、襄、貴州有功也。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Baojing Pacification Commissioner's various tribal headmen's tax grain of eight hundred fifty-three shi for Chenghua 2 was remitted, for repeated mobilization campaigning in Guangxi and Jing, Xiang, and Guizhou with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year eight hundred fifty-three shi of Chenghua 2 grain tax owed by Baojing's tribal offices was remitted, for repeated meritorious service in Guangxi and the Jing, Xiang, and Guizhou campaigns.

sentences.zh: 七年，顯宗老不任事，命其子仕瓏代。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Xianzong was old and unable to attend to affairs; his son Shilong was ordered to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Xianzong, too old to govern, was replaced by his son Shilong.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以平苗功，顯宗、仕瓏皆進一階。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, for merit in pacifying the Miao, Xianzong and Shilong were each advanced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, for pacifying the Miao, Xianzong and Shilong were each promoted one grade.

sentences.zh: 十五年以災免保靖租賦。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, because of disaster, Baojing rents and levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Baojing's rents and levies were remitted on account of disaster.

sentences.zh: 仁瓏奏，兩江口長官彭勝祖違例進貢，下部臣議，宜逮問，命鎮巡官諭之。

translations.literal: Shilong memorialized that Two-River Mouth Chieftain Peng Shengzu presented tribute against regulations; the ministry deliberated he should be arrested and questioned; the emperor ordered pacification and inspection officials to admonish him.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong reported that Two-River Mouth Chieftain Peng Shengzu had presented tribute contrary to regulations; the ministry proposed arrest and inquiry; the emperor ordered the pacification and inspection officials to warn him.

sentences.zh: 弘治十二年，永順宣慰司奏，仕瓏擅率兵攻長官彭世英，仇殺多年，構禍不已，乞發兵征剿。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Hongzhi, Yongshun Pacification Commission memorialized that Shilong on his own led troops to attack Chieftain Peng Shiying; feuding and killing for many years, stirring calamity without end -- requesting dispatch of troops to suppress.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi 12 the Yongshun Pacification Commission reported that Shilong had on his own led troops against Chieftain Peng Shiying; their feud had raged for years without cease, and troops should be sent to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 部覆以屢行按問不報，宜諭鎮巡官速勘奏聞，從之。

translations.literal: The ministry replied that repeated investigations had reported nothing; they should admonish pacification and inspection officials to investigate quickly and memorialize -- approved.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry answered that repeated inquiries had gone unanswered; the pacification and inspection officials should be told to investigate promptly and report; approved.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以保靖宣慰等方聽調，免明年朝覲，時有征貴州賊婦米魯之役故也。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, because Baojing pacification commissioners and others were awaiting orders, next year's court audience was excused — at the time because of the campaign against the Guizhou bandit woman Milu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, because Baojing's pacification commissioners were on active service, next year's court audience was waived — owing to the campaign against the Guizhou rebel Milu.

sentences.zh: 初，保靖安撫彭萬里以洪武元年歸附，即其地設保靖宣慰司，授萬里宣慰使，領白崖、大別、大江、小江等二十八村寨。

translations.literal: Earlier, Baojing comforting commissioner Peng Wanli submitted in the first year of Hongwu; at once the Baojing Pacification Commission was established on his territory, Wanli was made pacification commissioner, administering twenty-eight stockades including Baiya, Dabie, Dajiang, and Xiaojiang.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Baojing comforting commissioner Peng Wanli submitted in Hongwu 1; the Baojing Pacification Commission was established in his territory, with Wanli as pacification commissioner over twenty-eight stockades including Baiya, Dabie, Dajiang, and Xiaojiang.

sentences.zh: 萬里卒，子勇烈嗣。

translations.literal: Wanli died and his son Yonglie succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Wanli died, Yonglie inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 勇烈卒，子藥哈俾嗣，年幼。

translations.literal: Yonglie died and his son Yaohabi succeeded, still young.
translations.idiomatic: Yonglie died and his young son Yaohabi succeeded.

sentences.zh: 萬里弟麥谷踵之子大蟲可宜，諷土人奏己為副宣慰，同理司事，因殺藥哈俾而據其十四寨。

translations.literal: Wanli's younger brother Maiguzhong's son Dachong Keyi incited natives to memorialize that he should be vice pacification commissioner and jointly manage office affairs, then killed Yaohabi and seized his fourteen stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Dachong Keyi, son of Wanli's younger brother Maiguzhong, incited natives to ask that he be named vice pacification commissioner, then murdered Yaohabi and seized fourteen stockades.

sentences.zh: 事覺，逮問，死獄中，革副宣慰，而所據寨如故。

translations.literal: When the matter was exposed he was arrested and questioned, died in prison; the vice pacification post was abolished, yet the stockades he held remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Exposed, he was arrested, died in prison; the vice pacification post was abolished, but his seized stockades remained.

sentences.zh: 其後，勇烈之弟勇傑嗣，傳子南木杵，孫顯宗，曾孫仕瓏；

translations.literal: Afterward Yonglie's younger brother Yongjie succeeded, passing the line to son Nanmuzhu, grandson Xianzong, and great-grandson Shilong;
translations.idiomatic: Later Yongjie's line ran through son Nanmuzhu, grandson Xianzong, and great-grandson Shilong;

sentences.zh: 與大蟲可宜之子忠，忠子武，武子勝祖及其子世英，代為仇敵。

translations.literal: while Dachong Keyi's son Zhong, Zhong's son Wu, Wu's son Shengzu and Shengzu's son Shiying were enemies for generations.
translations.idiomatic: Dachong Keyi's line — Zhong, Wu, Shengzu, and Shengzu's son Shiying — were their hereditary enemies.

sentences.zh: 而武以正統中隨征有功，授兩江口長官，勝祖成化中亦以功授前職，並隨司理事，無印署。

translations.literal: Wu, for merit on campaign in Zhengtong, was made Liangjiangkou chieftain; Shengzu in Chenghua also received the former post for merit — both administered affairs with the commission but without seals.
translations.idiomatic: Wu earned Liangjiangkou chieftain in Zhengtong for campaign merit; Shengzu received the same post in Chenghua — both served the commission without formal seals.

sentences.zh: 弘治初，勝祖以年老，世英無官，恐仕瓏奪其地，援例求世襲，奏行核實，仕瓏輒沮之，以是仇恨益甚，兩家所轄土人亦各分黨仇殺。

translations.literal: Early in Hongzhi, Shengzu being old and Shiying without office, fearing Shilong would seize their lands, they cited precedent to seek hereditary succession; memorials went for verification but Shilong repeatedly obstructed — hatred deepened, and natives under both houses formed factions and killed one another.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Hongzhi, Shengzu aged and Shiying without office, fearing Shilong would seize their lands, they sought hereditary succession by precedent; Shilong blocked verification — hatred deepened and both sides' followers feuded.

sentences.zh: 永順宣慰使彭世麒取勝祖女，復左右之，以是互相攻擊，奏訴無寧歲。

translations.literal: Yongshun pacification commissioner Peng Shiqi took Shengzu's daughter in marriage and again favored their side — hence mutual attacks and memorials without a peaceful year.
translations.idiomatic: Yongshun's Peng Shiqi married Shengzu's daughter and favored their faction — attacks and lawsuits followed year after year.

sentences.zh: 弘治十年，巡撫沈暉奏言，令世英入粟嗣父職，將以平之，而仕瓏奏訐不止。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Hongzhi Grand Coordinator Shen Hui memorialized that Shiying should contribute grain to succeed his father to settle matters — yet Shilong's accusations did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi 10 Grand Coordinator Shen Hui proposed that Shiying contribute grain to succeed his father and settle the feud — yet Shilong's accusations continued.

sentences.zh: 是時，敕調世英從征貴州，而兵部移文有「兩江口長官司」字，仕瓏疑世英得設官署，將不聽約束，復奏言之。

translations.literal: At the time Shiying was ordered on the Guizhou campaign; the Ministry of War dispatch contained the words "Liangjiangkou chieftain's office" — Shilong suspected Shiying would gain an official seat and refuse restraint, and memorialized again.
translations.idiomatic: Shiying was ordered to the Guizhou campaign; a Ministry of War document mentioned "Liangjiangkou chieftain's office" — Shilong feared Shiying would gain an independent office and refuse restraint, and memorialized again.

sentences.zh: 於是巡撫閻仲宇、巡按王約等請以前後章奏下兵部、都察院，議：「令世英歸所據小江七寨於仕瓏，止領大江七寨，聽仕瓏約束。

translations.literal: Thereupon Grand Coordinator Yan Zhongyu, Touring Censor Wang Yue, and others asked that earlier and later memorials be sent to the Ministry of War and Censorate for deliberation: "Let Shiying return the seven Xiaojiang stockades he holds to Shilong, retaining only the seven Dajiang stockades, and obey Shilong's authority.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Yan Zhongyu and Touring Censor Wang Yue asked the ministries to deliberate: "Shiying should return seven Xiaojiang stockades to Shilong, keep seven Dajiang stockades, and obey Shilong.

sentences.zh: 其原居兩江口系襟喉要地，請調清水溪堡官兵守之。

translations.literal: Their original seat at Liangjiangkou is a strategic throat — request that Qingshuixi fort troops be transferred to guard it.
translations.idiomatic: Their original seat at Liangjiangkou is strategically vital — transfer Qingshuixi fort troops to guard it.

sentences.zh: 而徙世英於沱埠，以絕爭端。

translations.literal: Move Shiying to Tuobu to end the dispute.
translations.idiomatic: Relocate Shiying to Tuobu to end the dispute.

sentences.zh: 以後土官應襲子弟，悉令入學，漸染風化，以格頑冥。

translations.literal: Henceforth all native heirs should enter schools, gradually receiving civilization to reform stubbornness.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth all native heirs should attend school to absorb civilization and reform stubborn ways.

sentences.zh: 如不入學者，不準承襲。

translations.literal: Those who do not enter school shall not be allowed succession.
translations.idiomatic: Those who refuse schooling shall not succeed.

sentences.zh: 世麒黨於世英，法當治，但從征湖廣頗效忠勤，已有旨許以功贖。

translations.literal: Shiqi sided with Shiying and should be punished by law, yet on campaign in Huguang he was quite loyal — an edict already permitted redemption by merit.
translations.idiomatic: Shiqi favored Shiying and was legally liable, yet his Huguang service was loyal — an edict already allowed merit to redeem guilt.

sentences.zh: 仕瓏、世英並逮問，勝祖照常例發遣。

translations.literal: Shilong and Shiying were both arrested for questioning; Shengzu was dispatched according to usual practice.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong and Shiying were both arrested; Shengzu was dealt with under usual procedure.

sentences.zh: 」奏上，從之。

translations.literal: " The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 弘治十六年六月事也。

translations.literal: This was the affair of the sixth month of the sixteenth year of Hongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: This occurred in the sixth month of Hongzhi 16.

sentences.zh: 正德十四年，保靖兩江口土舍彭惠既以祖大蟲可宜與彭藥哈俾世仇，至是與宣慰彭九霄復構怨。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Zhengde, Baojing Liangjiangkou native cadet Peng Hui, bearing the hereditary feud between his grandfather Dachong Keyi and Peng Yaohabi, now renewed enmity with pacification commissioner Peng Jiuxiao.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 14 Baojing's Peng Hui of Liangjiangkou, heir to the feud of Dachong Keyi and Yaohabi, renewed strife with pacification commissioner Peng Jiuxiao.

sentences.zh: 永順宣慰彭明輔與之連姻，助以兵力，遂與九霄往復仇殺，數年不息，死者五百余人，前後訐奏累八十余章。

translations.literal: Yongshun pacification commissioner Peng Mingfu was allied by marriage and aided with troops — hence repeated vendetta killings with Jiuxiao for years without end, more than five hundred dead and over eighty mutual accusation memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Yongshun's Peng Mingfu, allied by marriage, sent troops — vendetta killings with Jiuxiao continued for years, five hundred dead and eighty accusation memorials.

sentences.zh: 守巡官系惠於獄，明輔率眾劫之去，尋復捕系。

translations.literal: Defense officials imprisoned Hui; Mingfu led a crowd to rescue him, then he was captured again.
translations.idiomatic: Defense officials jailed Hui; Mingfu led men to free him, then he was seized again.

sentences.zh: 事聞，詔都御史吳廷舉勘處。

translations.literal: When reported, an edict ordered Censor-in-Chief Wu Tingju to investigate and settle the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Reported, an edict ordered Censor-in-Chief Wu Tingju to investigate.

sentences.zh: 廷舉乃令鎮巡議，以為惠罪當誅，但土蠻難盡以法繩，宜徙惠置辰、常城中，令九霄出價以易兩江口故地。

translations.literal: Tingju had regional officials deliberate and held that Hui's crime warranted execution, yet tribal peoples are hard to bind fully by law — Hui should be moved within Chen and Chang prefecture cities, and Jiuxiao should pay to exchange the old Liangjiangkou lands.
translations.idiomatic: Tingju had officials deliberate: Hui deserved death, yet tribes are hard to bind by statute — move Hui to Chen and Chang cities and let Jiuxiao buy back Liangjiangkou.

sentences.zh: 仍用文官左遷者二人為首領官，以勸相之。

translations.literal: Still employ two demoted civil officials as headmen to encourage and assist.
translations.idiomatic: Employ two demoted civil officials as headmen to guide them.

sentences.zh: 俟數年後革心向化，請敕獎諭，仍擢用為首領。

translations.literal: After several years, if hearts reform and they turn to civilization, request imperial praise and promotion back to headmen.
translations.idiomatic: After years, if they reform, request imperial praise and restore them as headmen.

sentences.zh: 下兵部議，以惠徙內地，恐貽後患，令廷舉再議。

translations.literal: Sent down to the Ministry of War — moving Hui inland might leave later trouble; Tingju was ordered to deliberate again.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War feared moving Hui inland would breed later trouble and ordered Tingju to reconsider.

sentences.zh: 於是廷舉等復請以大江之右五寨歸保靖，大江之左二寨屬辰州，設大剌巡檢司，流官一人主之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Tingju and others again asked that the five stockades east of the Great River return to Baojing, the two west of the river belong to Chen prefecture, and a Dalai inspection office be established under one regular official.
translations.idiomatic: Tingju then proposed five stockades east of the Great River for Baojing, two west for Chen prefecture, and a Dalai inspection office under a regular official.

sentences.zh: 惠免遷徙，仍居沱埠，以土舍名目協理巡檢事。

translations.literal: Hui was exempted from relocation, remaining at Tuobu under the native cadet title to assist inspection affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Hui was not relocated, remaining at Tuobu as native cadet to assist the inspector.

sentences.zh: 部覆如廷舉言。

translations.literal: The ministry approved as Tingju proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry approved Tingju's proposal.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖六年以擒岑猛功進九霄湖廣參政，賜銀幣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiajing, for merit in capturing Cen Meng, Jiuxiao was promoted to Huguang administration commissioner and given silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 6, for capturing Cen Meng, Jiuxiao was made Huguang administration commissioner with silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 長子虎臣戰歿，贈指揮僉事，次子良臣襲職時，免赴京。

translations.literal: The eldest son Huchen died in battle and was posthumously made assistant regional commander; when the second son Liangchen succeeded, attendance at court was waived.
translations.idiomatic: Eldest son Huchen died in battle and was posthumously made assistant regional commander; second son Liangchen succeeded with court attendance waived.

sentences.zh: 二十六年免保靖秋糧。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year Baojing autumn grain was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Baojing's autumn grain tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 三十三年詔調宣慰彭藎臣帥所部三千人赴蘇、松征倭。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year an edict ordered pacification commissioner Peng Jinchen to lead three thousand men to Suzhou and Songjiang against Japanese pirates.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year an edict ordered Peng Jinchen to lead three thousand men against Japanese pirates in Suzhou and Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 明年遇倭於石塘彎，大戰，敗之。

translations.literal: The next year they met pirates at Shitang Bay, fought a great battle, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The next year they met pirates at Shitang Bay, fought fiercely, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 賊北走平望，諸軍尾之於王江涇，大破之。

translations.literal: The bandits fled north to Pingwang; the armies pursued to Wangjiangjing and broke them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders fled to Pingwang; pursuers caught them at Wangjiangjing and shattered them.

sentences.zh: 錄功，以保靖為首，敕賜藎臣銀幣並三品服，令統兵益擊賊。

translations.literal: Merit was recorded with Baojing first; an edict granted Jinchen silver, silks, and third-rank robes and ordered him to press the attack.
translations.idiomatic: Merit was recorded with Baojing first; Jinchen received silver, silks, third-rank robes, and orders to press the attack.

sentences.zh: 先是，都司李經率保靖兵追倭至新場，倭二千人伏不出，保靖土舍彭翅引軍探之，中伏，與所部皆死，贈翅一官並賜棺殮具。

translations.literal: Earlier, Regional Vice Commander Li Jing led Baojing troops pursuing pirates to Xinchang; two thousand Japanese lay in ambush — Baojing native cadet Peng Chi led scouts, fell into the trap, and he and his men all died; Chi was posthumously given one rank and coffin fittings.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Li Jing led Baojing troops to Xinchang; two thousand Japanese ambushed them — Peng Chi and his scouts died; Chi received posthumous rank and coffin fittings.

sentences.zh: 及是，以王江涇捷，進藎臣為昭毅將軍。

translations.literal: Now, for the Wangjiangjing victory, Jinchen was promoted to Brave-and-Steadfast General.
translations.idiomatic: For Wangjiangjing, Jinchen was promoted to Brave-and-Steadfast General.

sentences.zh: 既又調保靖土兵六千赴總督軍前，從胡宗憲請也。

translations.literal: Then six thousand Baojing native troops were again mobilized to the grand coordinator's camp at Hu Zongxian's request.
translations.idiomatic: Six thousand more Baojing troops were sent to Grand Coordinator Hu Zongxian's camp.

sentences.zh: 時已敘趙文華、宗憲功，復加藎臣右參政，管宣慰司事，仍賞銀幣。

translations.literal: Merit for Zhao Wenhua and Zongxian had already been recorded; Jinchen was again made Right Administration Commissioner in charge of pacification affairs, with further silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhao Wenhua and Zongxian were rewarded, Jinchen was made Right Administration Commissioner managing pacification affairs, with more silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 萬歷四十七年調保靖兵五千，命宣慰彭象乾親統援遼。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year of Wanli five thousand Baojing troops were mobilized and pacification commissioner Peng Xiangqian ordered to lead them personally to aid Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 47 five thousand Baojing troops were mobilized under Peng Xiangqian for Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 四十八年加象乾指揮使。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year Xiangqian was given regional vice commander rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year Xiangqian received regional vice commander rank.

sentences.zh: 象乾至涿州病，中夜兵逃散者三千余人，部臣以聞。

translations.literal: Xiangqian fell ill at Zhuozhou; in the middle of the night more than three thousand soldiers deserted — the ministry reported this.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangqian fell ill at Zhuozhou; at midnight more than three thousand soldiers deserted — the ministry reported it.

sentences.zh: 帝嚴旨責統兵者，並敕監軍道沿途招撫。

translations.literal: The emperor issued a stern edict rebuking the commanders and ordered the military supervision circuit along the route to gather them back.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sternly rebuked the commanders and ordered supervision officials along the route to gather the deserters.

sentences.zh: 明年，象乾病不能行，遣其子侄率親兵出關，戰於渾河，全軍皆歿。

translations.literal: The next year Xiangqian was too ill to travel and sent sons and nephews leading personal troops beyond the pass; they fought at the Hun River and the whole force perished.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, too ill to march, Xiangqian sent sons and nephews beyond the pass; they fought at the Hun River and the entire force perished.

sentences.zh: 天啟二年進象乾都督僉事，贈彭象周、彭緄、彭天祐各都司僉書，以渾河之役一門殉戰，義烈為諸土司冠雲。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianqi Xiangqian was promoted to Regional Vice Commander; Peng Xiangzhou, Peng Gun, and Peng Tianyou were each posthumously given battalion vice commander rank in the regional command — for the Hun River battle the whole family died in battle, their loyalty and valor the foremost among all tribal headmen.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianqi 2 Xiangqian was promoted to Regional Vice Commander; Peng Xiangzhou, Peng Gun, and Peng Tianyou were posthumously made battalion vice commanders — at the Hun River the whole family died fighting, their loyalty unmatched among tribal headmen.
